tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: :rtsa gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa las: rig 'dzin mchog gi sgrub pa bzhugs:

rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud: 'od gsal snying po dgongs pa'i rgyud: rig 'dzin brda yi sku ru shar: skal ldan rnams la mtshon pa'i slad: snyan brgyud gdams shing gtad pa yis: ma 'ongs phyi ma phyi ma'i bar: byin rlabs rtsal 'chang mtha' yas pa: 'dzam gling kun tu khyab par 'byung: de dag rnams kyi nyams rtogs dang: ye shes yon tan skyed pa ni: byin rlabs kho nar nges pas na: gsang ba mchog gi sgrub pa 'di: gdams pa kun gyi snying por zungs: sa ma ya: 'di la spyi don rnam bzhi ste: dang po yo byad sta gon bya: gnyis pa sngon 'gros rgyud sbyong zhing: gsum pa dngos gzhis nyams su blang: bzhi pa rjes kyis mthar dbyung ngo: sa ma ya: dang po sta gon bya ba ni: gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod dam: rig 'dzin bla mas byin brlabs gnas: yid dang mthun pa'i sgrub khang du: bkra shis sa la stegs bu bya: bla ma yab yum byang sems dang: bdud rtsi lnga yis chag chag gdab: dkyil 'khor mtshan nyid rdzogs par bzhengs: dbus su bla ma'i sku 'bag dang: rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs gsung gi rten: byang sems gsang ba'i ril bu sogs: sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams dgod: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs rnams: bag dro brjid dang ldan par bsham: lta nyan 'byung po tshar bcad cing: srung ba'i 'khor los phyogs mtshams bcing: spos rol dbyangs kyi brdas mtshon te: byin chen dbab cing brtul zhugs bskyed: bde stong ngang du mnyam bzhag pas: byung tshor rtog pa rang grol nas: mos gus rdzogs pa chen po yi: nyams myong rgyud la 'char ba na: sgrub pa lam du longs par nges: sa ma ya: gnyis pa sngon 'gro'i rim pa la: rgyud sbyong mtshams bcad dam bca' bzung: byin chen dbab cing gnas khang dang: mchod pa'i longs spyod byin gyis brlab: de la dang por rgyud sbyang phyir: tshogs rten dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: chos rnams ye nas brdal ba chen po'i klong:

snod bcud rnam dag padmo bkod pa'i zhing: yid 'phrog ngo mtshar mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs pa: 'ja' zer thig le 'od phung 'khyil pa'i dbus: rang gi mdun du dpag bsam ljon pa'i shing: yal ga lnga ldan lo ma me tog mdzes: 'dod 'byung 'bras bu rab tu rgyas pa yi: dbus kyi yal gar seng khri pad zla'i steng: rtsa ba'i bla ma o rgyan rdo rje 'chang: mthing gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin yum dang 'khril: rin chen rus rgyan dar gyi na bzas bklubs: rdo rje'i skyil krung gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas: rtsa gsum kun 'dus chen por bzhugs pa yi: mtha' skor brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: mdun du yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang: g.yas su dus gsum sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku: rgyab tu mdo rgyud man ngag glegs bam tshogs: g.yon du theg pa che chung dge 'dun dang: bar mtshams mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha bcas: stong gsal ma 'gag ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid chen por gyur: de ltar gsal ba'i skyabs kyi 'og: bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam sems can 'khod: sgo gsum mos shing gdung ba'i blos: rtse gcig gus pas skyabs 'gror dmigs: na mo: mtha' yas byin rlabs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi: brgyud gsum bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi: mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i 'dren pa bla na med: bslu med dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi: dngos grub mchog stsol bde ba chen po'i sku: yi dam zhi khro'i lha la skyabs su mchi: phrin las thogs med sa lam bar chad sel: mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la skyabs su mchi: bdag dang rigs drug sems can ma lus kun: ji srid byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar: skyabs mgon re ltos gcig gyur khyed shes pas: byin rlabs smin grol dngos grub bstsal du gsol:1$0000250 de ltar rtse gcig gsol btab pas: tshogs zhing rnams las 'od zer 'phros: bdag gzhan sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyangs:

thar pa'i sa bon thebs par 1$0000300 bsam: smon 'jug sems bskyed dam bca' bzung: ho: ji ltar rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kyis: bla med byang chub snying por thugs bskyed ltar: bdag kyang mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don slad du: smon pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing: rang rgyud nyes par spyod pa yongs su sdom: thun mong khyad par mchog gi dge chos sdud: gsang sngags bla na med pa'i spyod pa yis: 'gro kun sku bzhi'i go 'phang 'god par bgyi: sdig ltung sbyang phyir smre bshags bya: na mo: skyabs gnas thugs rje'i bdag nyid dgongs su gsol: bdag gis thog med dus nas da lta'i bar: 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i don ma rtogs: gzung 'dzin dbang gis rnam rtog sna tshogs skyes: chags sdang dbang gis sdig pa'i las mang spyad: nyon mongs shugs drag gnyen po stobs chung bas: spyi dang khyad par lhag pas bsdus pa yi: dam tshig nyams chag nyes ltung ci mchis pa: snying nas 'gyod pa chen pos so sor bshags: mi 'chab mi sbed slan chad bsdam bgyid na: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: yi ge brgya pa ci nus bzla: 'gyod pa chen pos bshags pa las: 1$0000250nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i tshogs zhing dang: khyad par bla ma'i gsang gsum las: dkar dmar mthing gsum bdud rtsi'i rgyun: char bzhin babs nas sgo gsum zhugs: nyes ltung nyams chag kun sbyangs 1$0000300 bsam: tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir maṇḍal phul: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ri rab gling bzhi lha mi'i dpal 'byor sogs: mi mjed bye ba phrag brgya'i maṇḍa la: skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: 'gro kun sprul sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: bdag lus phung po khams dang skye mched bcas: yid bzhin 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i maṇḍa la: skyabs gnas rtsa ba gsum gyi tshogs la 'bul: 'gro kun longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: ye stong gdod nas dag pa'i mkha' dbyings su:

gsal mdangs ma 'gag ye shes maṇḍa la: skyabs gnas sku gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul: 'gro kun chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru de ba dhā ki nī sa pa ri bā ra ratna maṇḍa la pū dza āḥhūm̐: gsag sbyong kun gyi snying po ni: yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar bya: phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i skyabs gnas rab 'byams la: sgo gsum rtse gcig gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos bsham yid sprul rmad du byung ba yi: kun bzang mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod par bgyi: tshe rabs 'khor bar bsags pa'i sdig ltung kun: gnong zhing 'gyod pa'i sems kyis snying nas bshags: 'phags dang so skye'i rnam dkar dge tshogs la: dga' zhing spro bas rjes su yi rang ngo: bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams kun: mya ngan mi 'da' rdo rje'i skur bzhugs nas: ji srid 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur bar: zab cing rgya che'i chos 'khor bskor bar gsol: dge ba 'di dang dus gsum dge ba kun: byang chub snying por yongs su bsngos pa'i mthus: 'gro kun bla med theg pa'i snod gyur nas: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i go 'phang myur thob shog: rang rgyud dag phyir sdom bzung ni: ho: dkon mchog rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams dgongs: bdag gis byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar: mtha' yas 'gro ba kun gyi don bgyid phyir: tshul khrims rnam gsum mi gtang gzung bar bgyi: bde bar gshegs pa rdo rje rin po che: padma las kyi rigs su bzhugs pa yi: dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs rnams yongs bzung bzhin: rang gzhan don du rlabs chen spyod pa spyad: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang: yan lag rigs lnga'i dam tshig nyi shu lnga: rang bzhin lta ba'i ngang du mi 'da' ba'i: rdo rje mchog gsum dbyer med bsgrub par bgyi: khyad par byin rlabs 'jug pa'i phyir: mi phyed gus pas gsol ba gdab: e ma ho: 'od gsal snying po spros pa kun dang bral:

gzhon nu bum pa'i ye shes mkha' khyab 'phro: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: dgongs brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs: gnas lugs mngon sum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: bde stong zung 'jug sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i klong: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang byin rlabs sprin phung 'phro: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: brda brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs: bskyed rdzogs dgongs pa rtogs par byin gyis rlobs: rgyud lung man ngag zab mo'i smin grol gyis: skal ldan 'gro rnams rjes su 'dzin mdzad pa: 'das dang ma byon da lta dus gsum gyi: snyan brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la gsol ba 'debs: gzhan don lhun grub 'byung bar byin gyis rlobs mchog gsum rtsa gsum sku gsum rgya mtsho'i bdag: yon tan mnyam med thugs rje'i gter chen po: dus gsum skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos: rtsa ba'i bla ma mchog la gsol ba 'debs: thugs yid gcig tu 'dres par byin gyis rlobs: gsol ba 'debs so o rgyan rin po che: thugs rjes gzigs shig brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs: byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun gu ru mkhyen: byang chub bar du dgongs pas bzung du gsol: sgrib bzhi'i bag chags dag par byin gyis rlobs: dbang bzhi'i ye shes smin par byin gyis rlobs: lam bzhi'i rtsal chen rdzogs par byin gyis rlobs: sku bzhi'i 'bras bu thob par byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐: rtse gcig bsnyen pas thugs dam bskul: mthar thug dbang bzhi blang ba ni: spyi bo'i lha tshogs 'od zhu bla mar thim: bla ma dgyes pa chen pos gnas gsum nas: 'od zer byung ba rang gi gnas gsum thim: sgrib dag dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub thob: mthar ni dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang: snyoms zhugs bde stong chen po'i ngo bor zhu: rang la thim pas ye shes rgyud la smin:

gnas lugs gnyug ma'i de nyid mngon du gyur: rang rig ngo bo bla ma chos kyi sku: rang bzhin ma 'gag ye shes longs spyod rdzogs: thugs rje mos gus rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang: sku gsum bla ma'i phrin las mthar phyin shog: ces brjod dus gsum spros bral ngang: gnas lugs bla ma'i rang zhal blta: snang lugs mos gus lam du khyer: sgyu ma lta bu'i spyod pa bskyang: 'di ltar brtson pa'i rnal 'byor pa: bar gcod gegs zhi ye shes rgyas: gsang ba mchog gi rten 'brel kun: rtsol med 'byung ba'i nye lam mo: gnyis pa bgegs la bka' bsgo zhing: rdo rje srung mtshams bcad pa ni: rang nyid gtum chen he ru ka'i: 'bar ba chen po'i brtul zhugs kyis: hūm̐: sa gsum gnas pa'i log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: gsang sngags sgrub la blta bar mi dbang kun: rdo rje'i gnas 'dir 'dug pa'i skabs med pas: rang rang so so'i gnas su bde bar dengs: gal te mi nyan gnod cing 'tshe byed na: rang bzhin ngang gis khro bo'i ye shes rtsal: thugs rje khros pa'i cho 'phrul mtha' yas pas: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brlag par 'gyur: drag sngags brjod cing thun gyis gzir: hūm̐: bdag nyid 'bar ba chen po'i ye shes sprin: rdo rje srung ba'i 'khor los phyogs mtshams khyab: phyag mtshan me phung gur khang gcig tu 'khyil: pho nya du mas mtshams kyi phrin las mdzad: bar gcod bdud tshogs 'jug pa'i skabs med cing: cir snang lha sngags chos sku'i rol pa ches: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i bgegs tshogs mtshams bcad do: badzra pañtsa dzñā na dzwa la kro dha rakṣa hūm̐ bhrūm̐ hūm̐: gsum pa dam bca' bzung ba ni: hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: dag mnyam chos sku'i dbyings su ro gcig kyang: gzung 'dzin rtog pas bcad pa'i ma rig sgo: rang rig ye shes thabs kyi phyag rgyas dbye: bhrūm̐ dzñā na pra be sha ya phaṭa:hūm̐: gdod nas rnam dag byang chub sems kyi dbyings:

ye shes sgyu ma rig 'dzin bla ma lha: rig pa 'od gsal ngang du ro gcig pas: ngo mtshar chen po'i brda yis phyag bgyi 'o: a ti pū ho: pra ti tsa ho: hūm̐: bder gshegs snying po gdod nas dag pa la: ma rig dbang gis sgro dang skur btab ste: nyon mongs 'khrul pa'i las sgrib ci bsags pa: lha dang rtog pa dbyer med klong du bshags: dzñā na sa ma ya shuddhe a: ho: kun tu bzang po'i spyod yul rmad po che: rdo rje'i dam tshig mchog tu lhun rdzogs pa'i: byang chub sems mchog mi 'da' phyag rgya che: sku dang ye shes dbyer med ngang du bzung: dzñā na sa ma ya a: oṃ: 'di ltar snang ba'i chos rnams ma lus kun: snang stong dbyer med phyag rgya'i dam tshig gis: rig 'dzin bla ma'i go 'phang bsgrub par bgyi: rdo rje sku yi gzi byin lus la phob: kā ya sa ma ya oṃ: ā: srid pa gsum gyi sgra skad ji snyed kun: grags stong dbyer med sngags kyi dam tshig gis: rig 'dzin bla ma'i go 'phang bsgrub par bgyi: snying po sngags kyi nus pa ngag la stsol: wā ka sa ma ya ā: hūm̐: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i rtog tshogs ji snyed kun: rig stong dbyer med ye shes dam tshig gis: rig 'dzin bla ma'i go 'phang bsgrub par bgyi: 'od gsal thugs kyi dgongs pa yid la sbor: tsitta sa ma ya hūm̐: ho: rtsa rlung thig le rtog tshogs rnam dag dbyings: ye shes rmad byung rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs: rig 'dzin bla ma'i ngo bor dbyer med pa: 'du 'bral med pa'i dam tshig bzung bar bgyi: dzñā na sa ma ya ho: bzhi pa byin chen dbab pa ni: zhwa gos rgyan gyis gzi byin bskyed: spos dang rol mo'i brdas mtshon te: gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis thugs dam bskul: hūm̐ hrī: ma bcos spros bral chos sku'i pho brang nas: sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha: dgongs brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: byin chen byin phob dbang dang dngos grub stsol:

ma 'gag bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas: rig rtsal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i skur snang ba: brda brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: byin chen byin phob dbang dang dngos grub stsol: gang 'dul 'gro ba sgrol ba'i pho brang nas: smin grol byin rlabs dngos grub sprin phung 'phro: snyan brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: byin chen byin phob dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: rig 'dzin bla ma'i byin rlabs lams se lam: yi dam lha tshogs dngos grub sha ra ra: mkha' 'gro chos skyong phrin las 'u ru ru: rdo rje'i glu dang gar thabs mkha' la sgyur: ma 'gag gsung gi rang sgra snang srid khyab: 'od gsal thugs kyi dgongs pa kun la brdal: byin chen byin phob rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: dbang chen dbang skur yi dam zhi khro'i lha: dngos grub mchog stsol dpa' bo dhā ki nī: rab 'byams rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis: sgrub pa'i gzhal yas 'di la byin chen phob: dkyil 'khor sgrub rdzas rnams la gzi byin skyed: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor rgyud la rtogs pa spor: snang srid lha yi phyag rgyar byin phob cig: sgra grags sngags kyi dbyangs su byin phob cig: dran rtog ye shes chen por byin phob cig: bde stong dbyer med sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i klong: sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī dzñā na ā be sha ya a ā: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: e ā ralli hriṃ hriṃ pheṃ pheṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐:1$0000250 bla ma rtsa gsum lha tshogs rnams: sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgyar sad: bdag gnas yo byad rdzas la thim: bde chen gzi byin 'bar bar1$0000300

bsam: lnga pa gnas dang yo byad rnams: byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: bdag nyid rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs ka nas: raṃ las lhag mthong me yis dngos 'dzin bsregs: yaṃ las rig rtsal rlung gis bag chags gtor: khaṃ las zhi gnas chu yis nyes skyon sbyangs: snod bcud 'od gsal thig le chen po'i ngang: oṃ yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du'i rol pa las: chos dbyings ye shes zhing dang gzhal med khang: ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i bkod pa 'byams klas dbus: hūm̐ las nyer spyod 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin: me long ye shes nam mkha'i mdzod du shar: trāṃ yig las byung dar dang rin chen rgyan: mnyam nyid ye shes lhun grub drwa bar rdzogs: hrīḥyig yongs gyur rdo rje'i rig ma yis: so sor rtog pa'i rol mos zhing kun g.yo: āḥlas gzhan yang dpag med mchod pa'i tshogs: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes sgyu ma'i tshogs: kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ badzra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bi dyā shabda rū pa shabda gandhe ra sa sparshe sarba pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: hūm̐ hrī: 'od gsal dbyings las ye shes me rlung dang: rnam thar gsum ldan thod pa'i sgyed pu'i steng: bde stong dbyer med 'dod 'byung ka pā lar: ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i bcud du 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: hūm̐ hrī: dung chen snod du khams gsum khrag mtsho bskyil: gīrti'i mkha' nas bde ba'i rgyun chen 'beb: chags bral so sor rtog pa'i rig mdangs rtsal: dbyer med bde mchog bde ba'i rol par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: hūm̐ hrī: gtor snod srid zhi brdal ba'i dbyings chen por: dam tshig rdzas mchog rig lnga ye shes lnga: dbyer med 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i gter chen po: rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes skong chen por gyur:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba ti gu hya sa ma ye hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: des ni sngon 'gro'i las rim rdzogs: sa ma ya: gsum pa dngos gzhi'i las rim la: dam tshig 'khor lo bskyed cing gsal: ye shes 'khor lo dgug cing bstim: mchod bstod bzlas pas thugs dam bskul: de la dang po bskyed pa niḥ oṃ: chos kun snying po ma bcos de bzhin nyid: gdod nas rnam dag rig stong ye shes sems: gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtshan ma las 'das pa: nam mkha' bzhin du brdal khyab chen por bsgom: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra dharma dhā tu ātma ko3 haṃ: ā: de ltar ma rtogs mtha' yas 'gro ba la: dmigs med snying rjes kun tu snang ba'i sems: rten cing 'brel 'byung sgyu ma lta bu'i tshul: mkha' las nyi ltar yongs la khyab par bsgom: oṃ badzra ma hā kā ru ṇi kā dzñā na swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: stong pa nyid dang snying rje zung 'jug pa'i: 'khor 'das kun 'byung rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐: nam mkha'i klong nas 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar: bzung bas mi zin chu zla'i tshul du bsgom: oṃ badzra dzñā na tsitta sa ma ya ātma ko3 haṃ: hrī: snang stong dbyer med hūm̐ gi rol rtsal las: ye shes lnga ldan cho 'phrul bsam mi khyab: 'bar ba chen po'i 'od zer phyogs kun snang: gzung 'dzin dngos po 'od gsal dbyings su sbyangs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: rgyu las e spros kun bzang nam mkha'i klong: yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor rgya gram steng: raṃ las bskal pa sreg pa'i me chen 'bar: baṃ las yan lag brgyad ldan rgya mtsho 'khyil: laṃ las rin chen gser gyi sa gzhi brdal: de dbus suṃ las rin chen rang bzhin gyi: ri rab lhun po brtan cing brjid par gyur: e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ maṇḍa la āḥhūm̐: ri rab steng du rdo rje'i srung 'khor dbus: bhrūm̐ las ye shes lnga ldan gzhal yas khang: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan:

rin chen rnam lnga'i rang bzhin rtsig pa dang: pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed shar bus brgyan: rdo rje nor bu'i phyur bur tog gis mdzes: 'dod pa'i snam bur mchod pa'i lha mos bskor: sangs rgyas ye shes byang chub phyogs kyi chos: brda don rtags kyi rnam par yongs shar ba'i: rang rig padmo bkod pa'i gzhal med khang: ye shes yon tan rang snang rgyan du rdzogs: bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi mā na maṇḍa la āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: gzhal yas dbus su rnam thar brgyad ldan pa'i: rin chen zur brgyad snang stong 'od 'bar ba'i: lte bar paṃ las chags bral padma dang: ma dang a las bde stong nyi zla'i gdan: ye shes rol pa'i 'od zer drwa ba'i sprin: phyi nang dngos kun yongs su khyab par brdal: ratna padma sūrya tsand+ra maṇḍa la āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: snying rje chen po'i thugs dam lcags kyu yis: rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐ yig bskul ba las: skar chen thang la babs pa'i tshul ltar du: nam mkha'i sa bon gdan gyi steng du bzhugs: dkar dmar mdangs ldan 'od zer 'phro 'du las: rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte bar hūm̐ gis mtshan: yongs gyur bdag nyid rig 'dzin padma 'byung: dgongs brda snyan brgyud bla ma kun gyi dngos: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag che ba'i mchog: bde stong zung 'jug dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs: dga' bzhi'i ye shes bcu drug lang tsho can: zhal gcig phyag gnyis snang stong 'od du 'bar: bde ba chen po'i rdo rje'i gsang gos steng: sngags kyi chas rdzogs mthing nag phod chen dang: rab byung cha lugs chos gos rnam gsum gsol: byang chub sems dpa' 'khor los sgyur ba'i tshul: dbang gi mdog can zab ber brjid par bklubs: zhabs gnyis g.yo med rdo rje'i skyil krung bcings: phyag g.yas rdo rje snang stong zung 'jug pa: bum pa'i dbang rdzogs thugs ka'i stod du 'dzin: g.yon pas mnyam gzhag bandha tshe bum bcas: gsang ba'i dbang rdzogs byang sems bdud rtsis gtams:

gru mor shes rab ye shes kha ṭwāṃ tshul: lhan skyes nye rgyu'i spyod pa'i phyag rgya 'khril: dbu la 'dab ldan padma'i snyan zhu gsol: ye shes dbang rdzogs sgro dar me long brgyan: snang srid zil gnon 'ja' zer thig le'i klong: sku bzhi dbyer med bde ba chen por bzhugs: hūm̐: de yi spyi gtsug pad sdong nyi zla'i steng: gsang ba kun 'dzin phyag na rdo rje mthing: thabs shes dbyer med rdo rje dril bu bsnams: g.yas su mkhyen rab mnga' bdag 'jam pa'i dbyangs: gser mdog ye shes ral gri glegs bam 'dzin: g.yon du thugs rje'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs: dkar gsal mchog sbyin phyag rgya padma 'chang: gsum ka dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: snang stong zung 'jug mtshan dpe'i phung por 'bar: phyogs bzhir padma 'dab bzhi'i snying po ru: shar du yi dam lha yi dbang thob pa: dga' rab rdo rje dkar gsal sprul sku'i tshul: sa gnon mnyam gzhag mtshan dang dpe byad ldan: chos gos gsum gsol rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs: lho ru glegs bam dbang thob rgyal po dzaḥ dkar gsal brjid ldan rgyud lung glegs bam bsnams: 'khor los sgyur ba chen po'i cha byad 'chang: nub tu rig rtsal dbang thob shrī siṃ ha: dmar smug sdigs mdzub thod pa bcud bkang bsnams: rnal 'byor brtul zhugs spyod pa'i tshul gyis rol: byang du bshes gnyen dbang thob sangs rgyas gsang: dkar mdzes phyag gnyis chos 'chad phyag rgya mdzad: sde snod 'dzin pa chen po'i tshul du bzhugs: bar mtshams rigs can drwa ma rnam lnga sogs: lha klu mi yi rig 'dzin bsam mi khyab: ma 'gag rang shar rol pa'i tshul du gsal: hūm̐: gsang bdag dbu gtsug pad sdong nyi zla'i dbus: gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku kun tu bzang: gcer bu mthing gsal mnyam gzhag skyil krung bzhugs: rang 'od kun tu bzang mo yum dang 'khril: mdun du chos dbyings ye shes rnam snang mdzad:

de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi tshom bus bskor: shar du me long ye shes rdo rje sems: rdo rje rigs mchog bye ba bsam yas 'phro: lho ru mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen 'byung: rin chen rigs mchog mtha' yas spro zhing bsdu: nub tu sor rtog ye shes snang mtha' yas: padma'i rigs mchog nyi dang 'od zer bzhin: byang du bya grub ye shes don yod grub: las kyi rigs mchog gtso 'khor bsam mi khyab: kun kyang longs spyod yongs rdzogs rgyan gyis mdzes: kha sbyor bdun gyi bdag nyid chen por bzhugs: zhi las ye shes rnam khros 'bar ba'i tshul: che mchog la sogs sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha: sku mdog phyag mtshan ma nges cir yang ston: rang snang longs sku'i zhing khams chen por brdal: hūm̐: gsang mchog bde chen padma thod phreng gi: g.yas su bde ba'i yum mchog mandā ra: 'chi med mchog stsol mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: g.yon du stong pa'i yum mchog mtsho rgyal lcam: dga' bzhi'i bde ster bdud rtsi'i bandha 'dzin: gnyis ka dar dang ratna utpal brgyan: dkar dmar mdangs ldan zhi 'dzum dgyes chags nyams: sems ma'i skyil krung 'ja' zer thig le'i dbus: bde chen ye shes skyed pa'i tshul du bzhugs: hūm̐: phyi rim rin chen zur brgyad 'od lnga'i klong: sna tshogs padma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng: shar du dpal chen yang dag hūm̐ kā ra: rdo rje sems dpa'i gsang gos dkar po gsol: phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol: lho ru 'jam dpal khrag 'thung bshes gnyen rtsal: gshin rje'i gsang gos mthing nag brjid par bklubs: phyag gnyis rdo rje'i be con sdigs mdzub sgreng: nub tu rta mchog rol pa nā gārdzu: dbang gi gsang gos dmar po lhab lhub g.yo: phyag gnyis 'khar gsil bdud rtsi'i par bu bsnams: byang du rdo rje gzhon nu pra bha ha: phur pa'i gsang gos margad mdangs 'od 'tsher: phyag gnyis rgya gram 'dzin cing phur pa 'dril:

shar lhor mngon rdzogs dha na saṃskṛta: srid pa ma mo'i gsang gos smug nag brjid: phyag gnyis gsang ba'i rnge'u chung thod khrag bsnams: lho nub dpal chen che mchog bi ma la: bdud rtsi'i gsang gos ljang ser 'jam mnyen 'khril: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag thod pa bcud bkang bsnams: nub byang gsang bdag gu hya tsand+ra ni: 'jig rten zil gnon gsang gos mthing nag 'bar: phyag gnyis lcags kyu gdengs shing zhags pa 'phen: byang shar stobs ldan shāntiṃ garbha che: mngon spyod dmod pa'i gsang gos smug nag brjid: phyag gnyis gnam lcags 'beb cing gri gug gdengs: kun kyang dkar dmar mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'bar: padma'i zhwa mnabs dar gyi chos gos gsol: khro zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams 'gyur can: zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs sprul pa cir yang spro: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang bye ba 'bum sde'i dbus: ngo bo lha la rnam pa slob dpon tshul: mdangs gsal ma 'gag 'od skur lam mer bzhugs: hūm̐: de yi phyi rim khor yug mu khyud du: sna tshogs padma mdangs ldan 'od lnga'i klong: rigs 'dus bka' babs mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal: ting 'dzin g.yo med mnyam gzhag 'khor lo bsnams: yang dag bka' babs gnubs chen nam mkha'i snying: nyi zer la 'chib rnam 'phrul cir yang ston: gshin rje'i bka' babs sangs rgyas ye shes che: nyi zla gdan bting drag sngags phur bu gdengs: rta mgrin bka' babs rgyal ba mchog dbyangs ni: spyi gtsug rta zhal grags stong dbyangs su 'tsher: bdud rtsi'i bka' babs dzñā na ku mā ra: sra mkhregs brag las byang sems chu rgyun 'beb: phur pa'i bka' babs rdo rje bdud 'joms rtsal: rlung sems dbang sdud brag rir thogs med 'phyo: ma mo'i bka' babs 'brog mi dpal ye shes: srid pa'i ma mo las la bkol zhing 'gyed: dregs pa'i bka' babs rlangs chen shrī si ha: lha srin sde brgyad bran du khol zhing 'du: drag sngags bka' babs pa gor bai ro che:

ye shes spyan ldan kun mkhyen dgongs pa brnyes: rtogs pa'i bka' babs rgyal mo g.yu sgra snying: mnyam gzhag mi g.yo 'od gsal ngang du bzhugs: grub pa'i bka' babs a tsar ye shes dbyangs: mkha' spyod gnas su rdo rje'i gar gyis rol: khrag 'thung bka' babs sog po dzñā na shrī: brtul zhugs gcan gzan gdug pa'i gnya' nas 'dzin: spyod pa'i bka' babs sna nam ye shes sde: rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'i klong na bya ltar gshegs: bsad gso'i bka' babs mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang: phur pa gdengs pas tshar gcod rjes su 'dzin: mkhyen rab bka' babs ldan ma rtse mang zhabs: mi brjed gzungs thob chos sgo mtha' yas spro: ye shes bka' babs lo chen dpal brtsegs zhabs: gzhan sems kun mkhyen sde snod rgya mtsho 'dzin: zab mo'i bka' babs shud pu dpal gyi seng: thig le 'dzag med chu bo gyen du zlog: zhi khro'i bka' babs rgyal ba'i blo gros che: ro langs gser sgyur ngan song dong nas sprugs: bla ma'i bka' babs khye'u chung lo tsā ba: rang snang dbang 'dus nam mkha'i bya rnams 'dzin: rtogs pa'i bka' babs dran pa nam mkha' che: ye shes mngon gyur sems can gdug pa 'gugs: drag po'i bka' babs 'o bran dpal gyi dbang: byin rlabs nus ldan chu la nya ltar 'phyo: rgyud lung bka' babs rma thog rin po che: snang sems ro gcig pha waṃ zan du gsol: mngon spyod bka' babs dpal gyi rdo rje'i zhabs: ye shes gzi ldan brag rir thogs med bgrod: dmod pa'i bka' babs lang gro dkon mchog 'byung: ting 'dzin rtsal ldan gnam lcags thog ltar 'phen: dgongs pa'i bka' babs rgyal ba byang chub che: rig pa'i dbang thob nam mkhar skyil krung bzhugs: kun kyang grub pa chen po'i brtul zhugs kyis: rnam 'gyur ma nges sgyu 'phrul rdo rje'i tshul: dus gsum snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: spro zhing sdud pa'i bdag nyid chen por gsal:

hūm̐: dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi ru: pad nyi bdud bzhi pho mo bsnol ba'i steng: shar du rdo rje dpa' bo sku mdog dkar: zhi ba'i nyams ldan rdo rje thod khrag bsnams: lcags kyu thod 'dzin rdo rje'i yum dang 'khril: lho ru rin chen dpa' bo gser gyi mdog: sgeg pa'i nyams ldan rin chen thod khrag bsnams: zhags pa thod 'dzin rin chen yum dang 'khril: nub tu padma dpa' bo sku mdog dmar: chags pa'i nyams ldan padma thod khrag bsnams: lcags sgrog thod 'dzin padma'i yum dang 'khril: byang du karma dpa' bo ma rgad mdangs: drag po'i nyams ldan ral gri thod khrag 'dzin: dril bu thod 'dzin las kyi yum dang 'khril: kun kyang dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: thod skam dbu brgyan thod rlon do shal 'phyang: stag sham gsol zhing zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis: ye shes me 'od 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i klong: las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul du gsal: hūm̐: gzhan yang steng 'og bar mtshams thams cad du: rlung sems dbang thob rnam par smin pa dang: ye shes mngon gyur 'chi med tshe'i rig 'dzin: rdo rje'i gdung 'tshob zung 'jug phyag rgya che: sa bcu rgyun mtha'i sems dpa' lhun gyis grub: dam tshig dbang gi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'beb: shes rab rgyud 'grol bshad pa'i mdzod sgo dbye: man ngag lung brnyes rtogs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs: nyams chag skong bas dbugs chen 'byin pa yi: rig 'dzin slob dpon dus gsum 'byon pa dang: sangs rgyas byang sems yi dam dkyil 'khor lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha'i tshogs: nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin du: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams klong: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor lor gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru de ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la dzñā na kā ya ātma ko3 haṃ:

de ltar dam tshig gsal btab nas: sku gsung thugs su byin brlab bya: oṃ: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku: spyi bor zla steng oṃ yig dkar por gsal: snang stong zung 'jug phyag rgya'i dam tshig gis: mi phyed rdo rje'i sku ru byin gyis brlab: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: ā: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung: mgrin par padma'i steng du āḥdamar gsal: grags stong zung 'jug sngags kyi dam tshig gis: mi phyed rdo rje'i gsung du byin gyis brlab: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā wā ka badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs: thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ sngon gsal: rig stong zung 'jug ye shes dam tshig gis: mi phyed rdo rje'i thugs su byin gyis brlab: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā tsitta badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: ye shes rigs lnga'i dbang mchog bskur: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs snyoms zhugs 'od zer dang: bde ba'i sgra yis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun: rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings su spyan drangs te: dgyes pa chen po'i rol pas bzhugs par gyur: oṃ: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las rmad byung dbang chen pos: phung khams skye mched lha sngags ye shes dbyig: rigs mchog rnam lnga'i ngo bor dbang skur gsol: hūm̐ oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ.a bhi ṣiñtsa ku ru ho: hūm̐: rnam shes gnas 'gyur zhe sdang dag pa'i dbyings: chos dbyings ye shes chen por lhun grub pa: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rdo rjes: 'gyur med rdo rje'i rigs su dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā shun+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: oṃ: gzugs phung gnas 'gyur gti mug dag pa'i dbyings: me long ye shes chen por lhun grub pa: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi sku rdo rjes:

'pho med bde gshegs rigs su dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā ā darsha dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: trāṃ: tshor ba gnas 'gyur nga rgyal dag pa'i dbyings: mnyam nyid ye shes chen por lhun grub pa: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gyis: rtsol med rin chen rigs su dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā sā ma tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: hrī: 'du shes gnas 'gyur 'dod chags dag pa'i dbyings: sor rtog ye shes chen por lhun grub pa: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung rdo rjes: chags med padma'i rigs su dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā pra tya bekṣa ṇa dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: ā: 'du byed gnas 'gyur phrag dog dag pa'i dbyings: bya grub ye shes chen por lhun grub pa: dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las kyis: thogs med las kyi rigs su dbang bskur ro: oṃ ma hā kṛ tyā nuṣṭhā ṇa dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen thig le byang chub sems kyi sprin: ye shes bdud rtsi'i dbang skur chu rgyun gyis: lha tshogs spyi bo nas zhugs lus kun gang: phung po gnas 'gyur nyon mongs rnam par dag: bde ba'i rlabs g.yos dbang bzhi'i nus pa smin: lhag ma tshangs pa'i gnas su brtan pa las: zhi khro rigs lnga rigs kyi yum dang bcas: kha sbyor bde ba'i rol pas lham mer bzhugs: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa ātma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa ye shes dgug cing bstim: brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba la: dbyings nas ye shes snyan gsan dbab: hūm̐: stong pa shin tu rnal 'byor 'od gsal dbyings: gzung 'dzin spros pa'i mtshan ma las 'das kyang: ye shes snying rje sgyu ma'i rol pa ni: rtsa gsum lha tshogs bde chen skur bzhengs shig: oṃ gu ru sarba ta thā ga ta badzra sa mā dza: de nas spyan 'dren spos rol dang: gdung ba'i dbyangs kyi brdas bskul te:

hūm̐ hrī: bzhengs shig brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: dgongs shig zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha: gshegs shig gnas gsum mkha' 'gro chos srung tshogs: thugs rje chen po'i gzi byin bskyed du gsol: hūm̐ hrī: 'og min chos dbyings khyab brdal zhing khams nas: kun bzang rigs lnga sems dpa' yab yum sogs: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhengs: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: lha klu mi yi zhing khams rgya mtsho nas: rigs gsum rigs can tshom bu 'bum sde sogs: bde chen brda brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams bzhengs: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling: rdo rje sems dpa'i shel gyi khang bu nas: yi dam lha yi dbang thob dga' rab rje: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni za hor rgyal po'i khab: gsang sngags 'byung gnas chos kyi pho brang nas: glegs bam dbang thob skal ldan rgyal po dza: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni rang byung rdo rje'i gdan: pho brang theg pa dgu rim gzhal yas nas: rig pa rtsal gyi dbang thob shrī siṃ ha: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni rab snang kha che'i yul: sde snod rgyud sde'i 'byung gnas chen po nas: dge ba'i bshes kyi dbang thob sangs rgyas gsang: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hūm̐ hrī: yul gyi ming ni lho nub rnga yab gling: padma 'od kyi gzhal yas khang chen nas: bde gshegs kun 'dus rig 'dzin padma 'byung: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni ngo mtshar rgya gar yul: rang byung bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod du: yang dag grub pa'i slob dpon hūm̐ kā ra: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs:

yul gyi ming ni khyad 'phags sing nga'i yul: drag shul sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod du: 'jam dpal grub pa'i slob dpon mañdzu shrī: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni rang byung bal po'i yul: rab 'jigs lhun grub brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du: rta mchog sprul pa'i slob dpon nā gārdzu: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni yid 'phrog za hor yul: gtum chen laṅka brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du: phur pa grub pa'i slob dpon pra hasti: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni 'dod 'byung sa la'i yul: brtul zhugs gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod du: ma mo grub pa dha na saṃskṛta: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul: 'chi med padma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du: bdud rtsi grub pa'i slob dpon bi ma la: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni 'dod 'byung kha che'i yul: rngam bzhad he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du: dregs pa grub pa'i slob dpon gu hya pa: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni byin chen li yi yul: rtsub 'gyur lo ka brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du: drag sngags grub pa'i slob dpon shāntiṃ gar: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni rgya bod grub pa'i zhing: he ru ka yi gnas yul dur khrod du: dngos grub mchog brnyes brda brgyud rig 'dzin tshogs: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hūm̐ hrī: yul gyi ming ni ri bo ta la'i zhing: bkra shis brag phug mā ra ti ka ru: 'chi med grub pa'i rgyal mo mandā ra: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni bod khams dbu ru'i stod:

ti sgro brag dkar mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang du: bde chen grub pa'i dbang mo mtsho rgyal yum: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni dpal gyi chos 'khor che: bsam yas bar khang g.yu zhal 'bar ba ru: bde gshegs yongs 'dus bka' babs chos kyi rgyal: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni lho brag gnyan gyi gnas: mkhar chu gsang ba phug ring gzhal med du: yang dag bka' babs rdo rje nam mkha'i snying: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni ngam shod sbrags kyi lung: yang rdzong drag sngags shel gyi phug pa ru: gshin rje'i bka' babs sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni mchims phu nags kyi khrod: dbang chen dgyes pa dben rtsa'i phug pa ru: rta mgrin bka' babs rgyal ba mchog dbyangs rtsal: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni bkra shis yar mo'i ljongs: khrag 'thung pho brang shel gyi phug pa ru: bdud rtsi'i bka' babs dzñā na ku mā ra: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni gtsang rong bde ba'i tshal: rdzu 'phrul tshogs khang brag dmar ke'u tshang du: phur pa'i bka' babs sna nam bdud 'joms rtsal: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni yar mo stod kyi cha: sham po dpal brtsegs gangs kyi ra ba ru: ma mo'i bka' babs dpal gyi ye shes rtsal: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni lho mon spa gro'i nags: lha srin 'du gnas stag tshang seng phug tu: dregs pa'i bka' babs rlangs chen dpal gyi seng: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni brag dmar dpal gyi stod: rang byung g.ya' ma lung gi phug pa ru:

drag sngags bka' babs bai ro tsa na'i zhabs: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: yul gyi ming ni bod khams gling dgu'i ljongs: gu rus byin brlabs gnas mchog thams cad nas: zab don bka' babs rje 'bangs 'dus pa'i tshogs: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: gzhan yang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas dang: ri brag ljongs gsum chos 'khor rab 'byams nas: dus gsum snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hūm̐ hrī: gsang mchog rdo rje theg pa'i pho brang nas: rnam smin tshe dbang phyag chen lhun grub kyi: rig 'dzin sku brnyes rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob kun: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: mtha' yas gdul bya 'dren pa'i gnas mchog nas: dbang bskur rgyud bshad zab mo'i man ngag ston: nyams chag skong mdzad grub pa'i slob dpon rnams: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho nas: dngos grub char 'beb yi dam zhi khro'i lha: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: gdod nas grub pa'i gnas yul dur khrod nas: phrin las mchog stsol dpa' bo ḍā ki nī: dam can chos srung gter bdag tshogs rnams kun: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: tshad med bzhi ldan dkyil 'khor sgo skyong ba: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs: byin rlabs dngos grub stsol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs: hūm̐ hrī: rje btsun o rgyan padma thod phreng rtsal: rdo rje'i sku yis brtan g.yo kun la khyab: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho ba spu'i khung bur rdzogs: thugs rje rdzu 'phrul phrin las bsam mi khyab: khyad par bod khams gdul bya'i mgon gcig pu:

mos shing gdung bas rtse gcig thugs dam bskul: dam tshig sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin: brda dang rol mo'i sgra yis rgyud bskul na: glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs shig: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i sprin phung 'phro: dgongs pas byin rlabs ye shes lams se lam: rab 'byams yi dam zhi khro'i tshom bur brdal: dngos grub mchog stsol dzap dbyangs di ri ri: 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gzi byin 'bar: phrin las thogs med gar thabs khyugs se khyug: ye shes las dang chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: tshar gcod rjes 'dzin rnam rol sha ra ra: rtsa gsum dam can srung ma thams cad kun: myur ba nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'di la byin chen phob: sgrub rdzas dam tshig bdud rtsir byin gyis rlobs: sgrub mchog lus ngag yid la dbang bzhi skur: grub pa'i rtags dang mtshan ma myur du phyungs: rab 'byams theg pa'i bka' yi sgo dbye 'tshal: zab don gter gyi dngos grub ma lus stsol: man ngag snying po'i nyams rtogs rgyud la skyed: thun mong phrin las thogs med 'dod rgur sgyur: khyad par ye shes chen po'i byin gyis rlobs: phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad dbyings su sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra e hye hi: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: rtse gcig gdung bas rgyud bskul na: rtsa gsum lha tshogs nges par byon: de rtags lus bde ba spu gzings: ting 'dzin dgongs brgyud nyams myong 'char: spyan drangs ye shes dam tshig par: phyag rgya rnam bzhis 'gugs gzhug brtan: oṃ: snying rje'i lcags kyus thugs dam dbyings nas bskul: byams pa'i zhags pas dam tshig rten dang bsre: dga' ba'i sgrog gis rdo rje gsum du bcings: btang snyoms dril bus 'bral med dgyes pa bskyed:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: dzñā na sa ma yaswā bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: gnyis med dgyes par bzhugs su gsol: hūm̐ hrī: dam tshig dkyil 'khor rang snang phyag rgya'i dbyings: ye shes sgyu ma'i lha tshogs dbyer med par: dgyes pa chen pos dgongs shing bzhugs nas kyang: mchod bzhes dam skongs byin rlobs dngos grub stsol: sarba dzñā na sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: gsum pa mchod pa'i las rim la: thog mar phyag gis 'dud pa ni: na mo: skye 'gag 'gyur med phrin las thams cad rdzogs: brgyud gsum bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: rang byung thugs rjes 'gro ba ma lus sgrol: yi dam zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: yid bzhin las dang dngos grub char chen 'beb: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: rang snang dag pa rig pa'i lha tshogs la: gdod nas 'du 'bral med par phyag 'tshal lo: a ti pū ho: pra ti tsa ho: kun bzang phyi nang gsang ba dang: de nyid rmad byung mchod sprin 'bul: oṃ: nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting nge 'dzin chen po: kun 'byung mi zad 'dod rgu'i 'byung gnas che: kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho yis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rtag tu mnyes gyur cig: oṃ pa na peṃ: pe nu su ra to: ti pu pa ra mu: sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi hu: sa ma yo ta mu: sarba ma hā su kha siddhi hu: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ udga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: oṃ: phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho na: dngos 'byor yid sprul bdud rtsi'i mchod yon tshogs: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang bzhi'i chu bos smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badzra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā:

phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho na: dngos 'byor yid sprul dag byed zhabs bsil tshogs: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang bzhi'i chu bos smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badzra pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā: phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho na: dngos 'byor yid sprul mtshar sdug me tog tshogs: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang bzhi'i chu bos smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badzra puṣpe pra tītstsha swā hā: phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho na: dngos 'byor yid sprul dri zhim bdug spos tshogs: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang bzhi'i chu bos smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badzra dhū pe pra tītstsha swā hā: phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho na: dngos 'byor yid sprul snang gsal mar me'i tshogs: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang bzhi'i chu bos smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badzra ā lo ke pra tītstsha swā hā: phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho na: dngos 'byor yid sprul bsil ldan dri chab tshogs: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang bzhi'i chu bos smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badzra gandhe pra tītstsha swā hā: phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho na: dngos 'byor yid sprul bcud ldan zhal zas tshogs: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang bzhi'i chu bos smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badzra nai bidya pra tītstsha swā hā:

phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams rgya mtsho na: dngos 'byor yid sprul snyan 'gyur rol mo'i tshogs: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: dbang bzhi'i chu bos smin grol dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra badzra shabda pra tītstsha swā hā: oṃ: srid dang zhi ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi: snang stong rdo rje gzugs kyi mchod pa'i sprin: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: snang srid gzhir bzhengs phyag rgya'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga rū pa pra tītstsha oṃ: ā: srid dang zhi ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi: grags stong rdo rje sgra yi mchod pa'i sprin: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: snang srid gzhir bzhengs phyag rgya'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga shabda pra tītstsha ā: hūm̐: srid dang zhi ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi: tshor stong rdo rje dri yi mchod pa'i sprin: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: snang srid gzhir bzhengs phyag rgya'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga gandhe pra tītstsha hūm̐: trāṃ: srid dang zhi ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi: myang stong rdo rje ro yi mchod pa'i sprin: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: snang srid gzhir bzhengs phyag rgya'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga ra sa pra tītstsha trāṃ: hā: srid dang zhi ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi: gsal stong rdo rje reg bya'i mchod pa'i sprin: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: snang srid gzhir bzhengs phyag rgya'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga sparshe pra tītstsha hā: ho: srid dang zhi ba'i zhing khams rab 'byams kyi: bde stong rdo rje chos kyi mchod pa'i sprin: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: snang srid gzhir bzhengs phyag rgya'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga dharma dhā tu pra tītstsha ho:

hrī: gsal brtan ting 'dzin rol pa las byung ba'i: padma can sogs lang tsho'i 'jo sgeg can: glu gar rol mo 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis: mthong thos dran pas bde chen skyed nus pa'i: rdo rje'i rig ma nam mkha'i khams gang ba: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis bzhes nas kyang: dga' bzhi'i lhan skyes mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga ma hā su kha karma mu dra pū dza ho: hūm̐: e dbyings rdo rje srin po'i brub khung du: khams gsum gzung 'dzin ru dra ma lus bkug: wam̐ yig bde chen rdo rjes bsgral nas kyang: rnam shes 'od gsal thig le'i dbyings su thim: sha khrag zag med tshogs kyi mchod pa'i sprin: he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i longs spyod mchog: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas 'od gsal snying po'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ shrī badzra rā ga ma traṃ ru dra mā ra ya khā hi: ha ha hi hi he he hūm̐ phaṭa: ā: 'khor 'das chos kun gdod nas byang chub sems: gnyis med blo 'das chen po'i mchod pa'i sprin: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: rig stong zung 'jug don gyi dngos grub stsol: a dzñā na dhā tu a a: oṃ: rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong sbyar ba'i: dam tshig rdzas mchog pañtsa a mṛta: snang srid gdod nas dag pa'i mchod sprin mchog: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dang: khams gsum ka dag rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor cher: ma bcos lhun grub ngang du 'bul lags na: dgyes par bzhes nas phyi nang bar gcod sol: mthu dbang nus pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: ༈ gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku 'od dpag med// longs spyod yongs rdzogs padma gar gyi dbang*// sprul pa'i skur bzhengs mtsho skyes rdo rje la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/

'chi med grub pa'i dbang mo mandā ra// gsang chen kun gyi mdzod 'dzin mtsho rgyal lcam// ye shes spyan ldan lo chen bai ro la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ gangs can bstan 'gro'i nyin byed khri srong rje// bka' babs bdun ldan padma mdo sngags gling*// zab gter mnga' bdag rtsa brgyud bla ma la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin brda' yi brgyud// gang zag snyan brgyud mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud// rig 'dzin bla ma dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ gnas gsum mkha' 'gro chos srung gter gyi bdag /gtsang ris dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dge bsnyen sogs// snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams la// sman mchod 'bul lo tshe dbang mchog dngos stsol// sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi/ ༈ oṃ āḥhūm̐: bcud ldan bdud rtsi snying po can gyi dbus: gsang gsum byin rlabs rdo rje'i yi ge gsum: thabs shes gu hya'i phyag rgyas blangs shing myang: bde chen sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: kā ya siddhi oṃ: wā ka siddhi ā: tsitta siddhi hūm̐: ā: dung chen snod mchog lcang lor bcas pa ru: khams gsum bkug nas khrag gi rgya mtshor bskyil: gīrti'i mkha' nas gsang ba'i chu rgyun phab: chags med rakta'i lbu phreng dmar 'od 'phro: dpal gyi dam tshig gzi byin chen po'i rdzas: nyon mongs 'khor ba stongs pa'i mchod sprin che: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bde mchog bde ba'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā rakta khā hi: hūm̐: snod kyi 'jig rten yangs pa'i gtor gzhong du: bcud kyi sems can 'gro drug gtor mar sbyar:

'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin phung mkha' la 'phro: bkod pa chen po'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab: ri rab gtos dang rgya mtsho'i gting ltar zab: ye shes lnga ldan rmad byung mchod sprin 'di: bla ma rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dbang bcu'i ye shes dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā ba liṃ ta khā hi:

bzhi pa che ba'i yon tan rnams: rjes su dran pa'i bstod pa ni: oṃ: gdod nas rnam dag nang gsal bum sku'i klong: sku dang ye shes rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: rigs brgya rigs lnga rigs gcig kun tu bzang: dgongs brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: ā: lha gnas gsum sogs sprul pa'i zhing khams su: ye shes sku yi sgyu 'phrul cir yang shar: rigs gsum sems dpa' lha klu mi'i rig 'dzin: brda brgyud bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: ma 'khrul ka dag sngon gyi bskal pa la: lhun grub rig rtsal sindhu rgya mtsho'i gling: rgyu rkyen las 'das mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang: sor rtog ye shes 'od kyi sku ru shar: bde stong dkar dmar mtshan dpe'i phung por 'bar: bcu drug na tshod dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur rdzogs: thig le nyag gcig 'dzum khro'i zhal dang ldan: thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug phyag rgya yis: snang stong dbyer med rdo rje thugs kar gtod: gsal stong zung 'jug mnyam gzhag thod bum bsnams: bde chen nye rgyu'i kha ṭwāṃ g.yon du 'khril: ye shes rig rtsal padma'i snyan zhu gsol: sku la gsang gos bde chen 'du 'bral med: mthing nag phod chen sngags kyi brtul zhugs rdzogs: rnam gsum chos gos shākya'i rgyal tshab tshul: byang chub spyod pas 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir: srid zhi dbang sdud zab ber dmar smug bklubs: rdo rje'i skyil krung dus gsum bder gshegs dang: dbyer med mngon par sangs rgyas byang chub 'chang: che ba'i yon tan dar dang rin chen sogs: 'dod yon ma spangs ye shes rgyan du mdzes: bden gnyis dbyer med pad nyi zla ba'i steng: snang srid gzhir bzhengs 'od phung klong na bzhugs: dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i dngos: sku gsum dbyer med padma thod phreng rtsal: zhing khams rab 'byams spro dang bsdu ba'i gzhi: dran pas gdung sel byang chub lam sna 'dren:

rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen lhums su zhugs: sprul pa'i skur snang theg mchog ston pa che: yi dam lha dang gnyis med dbang mchog thob: dga' rab rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod: smon lam las sad chos kyi char chen babs: gsang bdag byin brlabs dgongs pa'i rtsal chen rdzogs: rgyud lung man ngag yongs kyi shing rta che: skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥl phyag 'tshal bstod: dur khrod rnams su brtul zhugs spyod pa mdzad: rdo rje gdan du kun bzang gdung 'tshob cing: rig rtsal dbang thob snang srid 'dod rgur sgyur: shrī siṃ ha'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jam dpal byin brlabs rig pa'i gnas la mkhas: sde snod rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i de nyid rtogs: rmad byung rdo rje theg pa'i dge ba'i bshes: sangs rgyas gsang ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: shes rab dbyings kyi lha mo tsandha lī: padma can gyi phyag rgya'i gzugs su sprul: 'chi med tshe la dbang thob ye shes brnyes: mandā ra ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod: bde mchog bde ba'i gar gyis srid pa sbyangs: zhi la mi gnas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lcam: mi brjed gzungs thob bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad: ye shes mtsho rgyal zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: dpal chen khrag 'thung chen po'i thugs kyi sras: rig 'dzin skur snang ye shes chen po brnyes: 'od gsal dgongs pas 'gro ba'i mun pa sel: slob dpon hūm̐ kā ra la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'jam dpal khrag 'thung chen po'i thugs kyi sras: 'khor lo rnam bzhi'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur: brtul zhugs chen pos bdud dang mu stegs 'dul: slob dpon mañdzu shrī la phyag 'tshal bstod: dbang chen padma gsung gi thugs kyi sras: rta skad thengs gsum 'khor 'das mnyam par brdal: chos sgo mtha' yas kun mkhyen rgyal tshab che: slob dpon nā gārdzu nar phyag 'tshal bstod:

dpal chen che mchog dgyes pa'i thugs kyi sras: snang srid bdud rtsi rnam dag dgongs par shar: paṇa chen lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan mkhas pa'i mchog: slob dpon bi ma la la phyag 'tshal bstod: phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs kyi sras: thal 'byin rnam bzhis srid pa phur bur rdzogs: mthu stobs nus pa byin rlabs gter chen 'chang: slob dpon pra hastir phyag 'tshal bstod: he ru ka dpal mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i sras: rtsa rlung thig le byang sems gding ldan pas: srid pa'i ma mo thams cad las la bkol: slob dpon saṃskṛta la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsang ba kun 'dus phyag na rdo rje'i sras: brten sgrub mchod pa'i las la rang dbang 'byor: dregs pa zil gnon ye shes gzi byin 'bar: slob dpon gu hya ba la phyag 'tshal bstod: gdug pa tshar gcod stobs ldan nag po'i sras: rdzong 'phrang srog gsum dgongs pa'i gding dang ldan: sa gsum log 'dren bsgral ba'i brtul zhugs can: slob dpon shāntiṃ garbhar phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: dgongs pa mngon gyur mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal: yang dag grub pa'i slob dpon nam mkha'i snying: 'jam dpal khrag 'thung sangs rgyas ye shes che: dbang chen bzhad pa rgyal ba mchog gi dbyangs: bdud rtsi'i bcud 'byin dzñā na ku mā ra: phrin las thogs med rdo rje bdud 'joms rtsal: rtsa rlung dbang thob 'brog mi dpal ye shes: dregs tshogs zil gnon rlangs chen dpal gyi seng: drag sngags thog 'beb kun mkhyen bai ro'i zhabs: dkyil 'khor gtso mchog rnams dang dbyer med pa'i: mchog gi rig 'dzin rdo rje slob dpon tshul: bka' babs grub chen dgu la phyag 'tshal bstod: rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas padma'i thugs kyi sras: snyan brgyud mdzod 'dzin sgyu 'phrul cir yang ston: 'od gsal mngon gyur g.yu sgra snying po sogs: rje 'bangs grub thob yongs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus gsum byon pa yi:

rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sar bzhugs byang chub sems: slob dpon bzhi yi tshul gyis skal ldan 'dren: rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'od gsal dbyings nas ye shes sgyu ma'i tshul: bde stong zung 'jug kha sbyor longs spyod rdzogs: zhi dang khro bo'i rnam rol cir yang ston: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod: rtsa rlung thig le'i gnas yul dur khrod du: lhan skyes ye shes phyag rgya'i gzugs su snang: bar gcod kun sel phyi nang phrin las mdzad: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dkyil 'khor sgo bzhi skyong mdzad he ru ka: rigs bzhi'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i rnam rol gyis: phyi nang mtshams srung las kun thogs med sgrub: sgo srung chos skyong tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐ hrī: snang stong zung 'jug ye shes phyag rgya'i sku: grags stong dbyer med ā li kā li'i gsung: rig stong khyab brdal 'od gsal gnyug ma'i thugs: rtsol med yon tan rang snang rgyan du thogs: gang 'dul phrin las gdul bya'i dpal du 'phro: byin rlabs sprin phung dngos grub char chen 'beb: las dang ye shes grub pa rgya mtsho'i mdzod: rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod che ba'i nga rgyal bskyed: lnga pa dzap kyi dgongs pa ni: bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan gyis: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dbyig: thugs kyi thig ler ro gcig bsgrub: de la thog mar rten brten pa'i: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs gsal snang la: rtse gcig sems bzung ting 'dzin bsgrub: che ba'i ye shes nga rgyal brtan: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la kā ya wa ka tsitta dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: gsal brtan gyad du gyur pa na: dgongs brgyud bla ma bsnyen pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: rig 'dzin 'dus pa bla ma'i dkyil 'khor lha: snang stong gzugs sku mtshan dper lams se lam:

grags stong sngags kyi dzap sgra 'u ru ru: rig stong zang thal ye shes sha ra ra: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dgongs pa gsal brtan cing: bzlas brjod rdo rje'i tshig gis rgyud bskul te: ma grub bar du rtse gcig bsgrub lags na: rig 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: zhes bskul dmigs pa'i sems 'dzin bya: kun tu bzang po rdo rje dbyings kyi lha: zhi khro yongs rdzogs dgongs brgyud bla ma yi: thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte bar hūm̐: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od zer tshogs: bdag la thim pas sgrib gnyis bag chags sbyangs: ye shes mchog gi gzi byin 'bar bar gyur: ces gsal sngags 'di sel med bzla: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu ā: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzhi yis byin brlabs smin: brda brgyud bla ma'i bsnyen pa ni: gsang bdag thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ mthing mthar: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor las 'od zer 'phros: bdag la thim pas mthu stobs nus pa bskyed: gsang ba thams cad 'dzin pa'i skal ldan gyur: oṃ badzra pā ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐: 'jam dpal thugs kar zla steng dhīḥser po: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor las 'od zer 'phros: bdag la thim pas ma rig rmongs pa bsal: gzungs dran spobs pa'i gter mdzod grol bar gyur: oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥhūm̐ swā hā: 'phags mchog thugs kar zla steng hrīḥdakar po: sngags kyi phreng bas bskor las 'od zer 'phros: bdag la thim pas rang don rtog sgrib spyangs: 'gro 'dul snying rje'i ye shes rgyas par 'gyur: oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐ hrī: dga' rab rdo rje'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las: 'od zer byung ba bdag gi gnas gsum thim: sgo gsum snang zhen bag chags thams cad sbyangs: yi dam lha dang dbyer med dbang thob gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru pra he badzra sarba siddhi hūm̐:

rgyal po dzaḥyi phyag gi glegs bam las: rgyud lung man ngag chos kyi char chen babs: dbyangs gsal 'od kyi rnam pas bdag la thim: chos sgo mtha' yas dngos grub thob par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru rā dza dzaḥsarba siddhi hūm̐: shrī siṃ ha'i thugs ka'i a yig las: rig rtsal ye shes lnga ldan 'od zer sprin: snying dbus mi shigs thig ler ro gcig thim: rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen thob par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru shrī siṃ ha sarba siddhi hūm̐: sangs rgyas gsang ba'i thugs ka'i dhīḥyig las: sde snod rgya mtsho'i ngo bo a dkar po: char ltar babs te rang la thim pa yis: bslab gsum ye shes yon tan yongs rdzogs gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru buddha gupta sarba siddhi hūm̐: gzhan yang brda brgyud rig 'dzin rgya mtsho yi: ye shes gzi byin thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis: phung khams rtsa rlung thig le byin gyis brlabs: grol ba bzhi ldan dgongs pa mngon du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐: 'di rnams 'bum phrag bzlas pa yis: khyad par ye shes smin par 'gyur: rig 'dzin yongs rdzogs sgrub pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: bdag nyid gtso mchog padma thod phreng gi: thugs kar pad nyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus: rdo rje rtse lnga'i lte bar hrīḥyig mthar: bden don bcu gnyis rdo rje'i sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer mkha' khyab 'phros: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams mchod pas brnyes: bde chen 'od zer bdud rtsis rang dbang bskur: nyams chag rtog sgrib thams cad dbyings su zhi: dbang bcu'i ye shes yon tan rig rtsal rgyas: snang ba dbang bsdus gzung 'dzin dgra bgegs bcom: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'dus pa'i dpal: mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i: dgongs pa mi g.yo 'od gsal thig ler 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma siddhi hūm̐:

'bum phrag bcu gnyis dngos grub thob: slar yang gsang mtshan thugs kyi yi ge las: sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan phyogs bcur 'phros: 'gro kun sgrib sbyangs rtsa gsum go 'phang bkod: snod bcud rgud pa zhi zhing gzi byin bskyed: dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs rnams zil gyis mnan: gdug cing gtum pa'i 'byung po tshar thag bcad: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las lhun gyis grub: tshur 'dus 'khor 'das dwangs bcud bdag la thim: thun mong mchog gi dngos grub thob par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas las kun byed: 'chi med mandā ra ba'i thugs ka ru: nyi zla kha sbyor hrīḥs mtshan sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer bdag la thim: 'chi med gnyug ma rdo rje'i srog 'grub gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ padma mandā ra sarba siddhi hūm̐: mtsho rgyal thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: baṃ yig sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer gyis: bdag rgyud byin rlabs thig le'i sgrib pa sbyangs: bde chen lhan skyes ye shes brtan par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ḍā ki nī ma hā su kha siddhi hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzlas pas ye shes skye: thugs kyi rig 'dzin rdo rje hūm̐ kā ra'i: thugs kar hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer bdag la thim: ru lu 'bru brgyad ye shes mngon du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru hūm̐ kā ra ru lu ru lu sarba siddhi hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: sku yi rig 'dzin 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyi: thugs kar yaḥmathar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer bdag la thim: 'khor lo rnam bzhi'i ye shes srog 'grub gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru mañdzu shrī ya mānta ka sarba siddhi hūm̐: gsung gi rig 'dzin nā gārdzu na yi: thugs kar hrīḥmathar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor:

bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer bdag la thim: rta skad thengs gsum snang srid ka dag gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru nā gārdzu na ha ya grī ba sarba siddhi hūm̐: phrin las rig 'dzin pra bha hasti yi: thugs kar hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer bdag la thim: thal 'byin rnam bzhis srid pa phur bur rdzogs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru pra bha hasti kī li kī la ya sarba siddhi hūm̐: mngon rdzogs rig 'dzin dha na saṃskṛta'i: thugs kar bhyo mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer bdag la thim: rtsa rlung thig le dbu ma'i dbyings su thim: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru dha na saṃskṛta gu hya dzñā na sarba siddhi bhyo hūm̐: yon tan rig 'dzin bi ma mi tra yi: thugs kar hrīḥmathar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer bdag la thim: snang srid ye shes bdud rtsi'i thig ler 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru bi ma la mi tra pañtsa a mṛta sarba siddhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭha: mchod bstod rig 'dzin gu hya tsand+ra yi: thugs kar hūm̐ mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer bdag la thim: 'jig rten dregs pa dbang 'dus bka' nyan gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru gu hya tsand+ra badzra pā ṇi sarba siddhi hūm̐ hūm̐: dmod pa'i rig 'dzin shāntiṃ garbha yi: thugs kar bhyo mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: bzlas pas rgyud bskul 'od zer bdag la thim: rdzong 'phrang srog gsum ye shes gzi byin 'bar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru shāntiṃ garbha sarba duṣṭān siddhi pha la hūm̐ e dza bhyo:

'bum phrag bzlas pas dgongs pa'i gding: brgyad ldan ye shes rgyud la 'char: snyan brgyud bla ma'i sgrub chen ni: bdag nyid gtso mchog padma thod phreng gi: bde chen ye shes dkyil 'khor kun tu khyab: rnal 'byor dbang phyug rje 'bangs thams cad kyi: thugs dam rgyud bskul rdo rje'i gar stabs bsgyur: bde ba'i 'od zer khams gsum kun tu 'phros: tha mal snang zhen bag chags bcas pa sbyangs: snod kyi 'jig rten padma drwa ba'i zhing: gzugs snang rig 'dzin bla ma'i phyag rgya'i sku: sgrar grags gzhom med mi shigs sngags kyi dbyangs: dran rtog dbyings rig dbyer med byang chub sems: yon tan rang byung phrin las lhun gyis grub: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams dang: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru yo gī shwa ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥsiddhi pha la hūm̐ ā: zhes dang yang gsang hūm̐ yig bzla: 'bum phrag bzhi yis snang zhen 'byongs: lha sngags ye shes srog 'grub 'gyur: mtha' rgyas phrin las kha bsgyur ni: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams thams cad kyi: thugs dam zab mo sngags kyis rgyud bskul bas: ye shes yon tan gzi byin bdag la thim: mchog tu mi 'gyur rtogs pa'i ye shes 'bar: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: 'bum phrag bzhi yis rtsa gsum gyi: thugs dam rgyud bskul byin brlabs 'gyur: rdo rje dpa' bo yab yum thugs ka ru: thugs srog sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer dkar: bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin snod bcud kun la khyab: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad mi mthun kun zhi gyur: oṃ ra badzra dhā ka ha badzra dhā ki nī oṃ shāntiṃ ku ru oṃ: rin chen dpa' bo yab yum thugs ka ru: thugs srog sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer ser: nyi ma'i mdangs ldan snod bcud kun la khyab: tshe bsod dpal 'byor legs tshogs rgyas par gyur:

oṃ tsa ratna dhā ka ri ratna dhā ki nī bhrūm̐ puṣṭiṃ ku ru swā hā: padma dpa' bo yab yum thugs ka ru: thugs srog sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer dmar: rjes chags rang bzhin snod bcud kun la khyab: khams gsum snang srid dbang du 'dus par gyur: oṃ hri padma dhā ka ni padma dhā ki nī hrīḥwa shaṃ ku ru ho: karma dpa' bo yab yum thugs ka ru: thugs srog sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od zer mthing: tsha zhing rtsub pas snod bcud kun la khyab: log 'dren dgra bgegs 'byung po tshar bcad gyur: oṃ ya karma dhā ka sa karma dhā ki nī hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭa: tho rangs zhi ba nyi shar rgyas: dgong mo dbang ste srod kyi dus: drag po'i las kyi dmigs bzlas bya: bdun phrag gcig gis las kun byed: sa ma ya: thun mtshams dbang gi chu bo yis: ye shes rig rtsal spar ba'i phyir: mchod cing bstod la nyams chag bshags: rtse gcig mos pas gsol gdab bya: hūm̐ hrī: yid bzhin kun 'byung mchod pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las ye shes bstod: nyams chag kun bshags dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā pū dza a mṛta rakta ba liṃ ta khā hi: oṃ: dkon mchog kun 'dus rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mos shing gdung bas rtse gcig gsol 'debs na: byin rlabs dbang gi ye shes chu bo ches: bdag rgyud smin grol dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru a bhi ṣiñtsa sarba siddhi hūm̐: rtse gcig bsnyen pas thugs dam bskul ba'i mthus: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis: brgyud gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: nam mkha' gang bar badzra sa mā dza: oṃ: nam mkha'i rdo rjes rigs lnga'i rgyal ba lngar: dgongs shing dbang mchog ji ltar bstsal pa bzhin:

mchod pa chen po ye shes brda yi dbang: rig 'dzin gdung 'tshob bdag la deng 'dir stsol: zhes pas gsol btab mkha' khyab rgyal ba las: grub pa'i slob dpon buddha gupta dang: rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum phrag du ma yis: mchod pa dang bcas phyi yi dbang bskur bsam: oṃ: byang chub bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur bas: phung khams gnas gyur rigs lnga'i ye shes brnyes: yongs su 'dzin pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen che: rgyal sras rdo rje 'dzin par mnga' gsol lo: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ dharma bast+ra a laṅkā ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: nam mkha'i lha las dga' rab rdo rje dang: rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum phrag du ma yis: mchod pa dang bcas nang gi dbang bskur bsam: hūm̐: rdo rje mi phyed gsum gyis dbang bskur bas: sgo gsum gnas 'gyur lha sngags ye shes brnyes: yi dam lha dang dbyer med gsang ba'i mdzod: rig pa 'dzin pa chen por mnga' gsol lo: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsitta a bhi ṣe ka ta oṃ āḥhūm̐: ma hā bidyā dhā ra bast+ra a laṅkā ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: nam mkha'i lha las skal ldan rgyal po dza: rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum phrag du ma yis: mchod pa dang bcas sgrub pa'i dbang bskur bsam: ho: rgyud lung man ngag glegs bam dbang bskur bas: dam pa'i mdzod gsum 'chad nyan sgrub la dbang: brtul zhugs spyod pas 'gro 'dul rig pa 'dzin: kun tu 'od kyi sa ru mnga' gsol lo: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sarba dharma pustaka a bhi ṣe ka ta hrī: shrī he ru ka a laṅkā ra a bhi ṣiñtsa mi: nam mkha'i lha las kun bzang shrī siṃ ha: rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum phrag du ma yis: mchod pa dang bcas gsang ba'i dbang bskur phyir: snyoms 'jug bdud rtsi'i sprin chen spros par bsam: ā: ji ltar kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen pos: byang chub sras la bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur ltar:

dkar dmar lhag pa'i ye shes chen po yis: ma chags padma'i sa ru dbang bskur ro: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu hya bo dhi tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: phyag rgya'i sgyu mas lhan skyes ye shes bskyed: hūm̐: lhan skyes ye shes 'byung ba'i padma can: sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig bla na med: rdo rje rig ma'i brtul zhugs la bsten nas: 'khor lo tshogs chen sa ru dbang bskur ro: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pra dzñā dzñā na mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: dpe yi thabs kyis don dam mngon gyur bsam: hrī: sems kyi chos nyid 'od gsal rdzogs pa che: bde chen thabs kyis mtshon pa'i de kho na: byin rlabs don gyi 'pho ba la brten nas: ye shes bla ma'i sa la lhun rdzogs shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ hūm̐: rgyal ba'i sras mchog padma thod phreng rtsal: sa lam yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag: dgongs pa thabs kyis 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir: rig 'dzin slob dpon chen por mnga' gsol lo: ma hā a tsarya a laṅkā ra a bhi ṣiñtsā mi: phyi nang sgrub pa gsang ba'i dbang thob pas: sgrib pa bzhi sbyangs dbang bzhi'i ye shes smin: lam bzhis rgyud grol dngos grub rnam bzhi thob: sku bzhi dbyer med chen po mngon du gyur: mkhar bzhugs dbang gi lha rnams rang la bstim: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta dzñā na swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: nga rgyal bzung zhing ye shes bskyed: ting nge 'dzin gyis lam gyi dbang: thun mtshams kun tu blangs pa yis: rig 'dzin rnams kyi gdung 'tshob cing: smin grol ye shes mthar phyin 'gyur: sa ma ya: bzhi pa rjes kyi las rim la: tshogs mchod bya zhing thugs dam bskul: dngos grub gsol zhing mtha' gnyis bsal: bsngo smon bya zhing shis pa brjod: dang po tshogs kyi mchod pa la: ma da na dang ba la sogs: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro dgyes skyed pa'i: dam tshig rdzas rnams 'du byas la:

phyi yi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i phyir: bsang chus bran cing bdud rtsi 'thor: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ye shes tshogs la nyes skyon ma mchis kyang: dam tshig rdzas kyi gnyis 'dzin sbyang ba'i phyir: gtum mo'i me yis dngos snang mtshan ma bsregs: srog rtsol rlung gis nyes pa'i dri ma gtor: byang sems chu yis rtog sgrib bag chags bkrus: snod bcud stong gsal rang byung gnyug ma'i ngang: bhrūm̐ las dbyings kyi bandha yangs pa ru: oṃ las ye shes lnga ldan tshogs mchod che: hūm̐ gis zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsir bsgyur: trāṃ las 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam mang po: hrīḥyis ngo mtshar kun tu bzang po'i sprin: āḥyis lha tshogs dgyes skong mchod par gyur: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: tshogs la byin chen dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrī: dbyings nas sku bskyod rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs: ye shes sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rab 'byams lha: zung 'jug rig rtsal mkha' 'gro ging laṅka: chos skyong srung ma 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs: dam tshig rdzas kyi 'du bar spyan 'dren na: thugs dam dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bde chen sku yi gar stabs shigs se shig: snying po dzap kyi sgra dbyangs 'u ru ru: 'od gsal thugs kyi dgongs pa lams se lam: rin chen rus rgyan dar dpyang pu ru ru: rkang gling gsang ba'i rnge'u chung sangs se sang: rnam mang dga' bzhi'i sgyu rtsal khyugs se khyug: myur ba nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang: gnas khang 'og min bde chen zhing du sgyur: rnal 'byor rig 'dzin gral du dbang mchog skur: dgongs rgyud ting 'dzin dag par byin chen phob: dam rdzas ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor skyil: thams cad bde mchog bde ba'i rol mo yis: he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i gzi byin skyed: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la e ā ralli ma hā su kha dzñā na dzwa la ā be sha ya sa ma ya st+waṃ:

dang po mchod pas dgyes pa bskyed: hūm̐ hrī: tshogs kyi ngo bo sku lnga ye shes lnga: tshogs kyi rang bzhin dam tshig bdud rtsi'i rdzas: tshogs kyi rang rtsal 'dod yon rgya mtshor 'khyil: tshogs kyi byed las zag med bde chen skyed: bla na med pa'i dgongs spyod chen po 'di: rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs la mchod pa 'bul: yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang: mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma las la skul: snang srid gzhir bzhengs dag pa rab 'byams mgron: dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa chen po bzhes: dgongs brgyud ting 'dzin dag pas byin gyis rlobs: las dang ye shes dngos grub ma lus stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā ga ṇa tsakra kā ma gu ṇa pū dza ho: bar pa skong bas nyams chag bshags: phyi mchod nyer spyod phreng ba bsham: nang mchod 'dod yon sna tshogs bstar: khyad par sman gtor rakta dang: mar me tshogs kyi longs spyod sogs: rmad byung rdo rje theg pa yi: mchod pa thams cad dpung bskyed la: zhwa gos brjid ldan dbyangs rol bcas: skong rdzas nam mkha'i mdzod du brlab: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: rig 'dzin rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes pa'i rdzas: bde ba'i ye shes rnam pa thams cad pa: skong rdzas nam mkha'i mdzod kyi gter du gyur: na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥsarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: hūm̐ hrī: rang byung gsang mchog rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor 'dir: dam tshig sgrub pa'i rdzas ni skar ltar bkram: ye shes rig rtsal dgongs pa nyi ltar brdal: dbyer med 'dod yon rol mo bsam mi khyab: 'og min gsang ba chen po'i maṇḍa lar: 'od gsal rang snang bkod pa'i rgyan stug po: lhag pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam 'phrul las: yul dang dbang po gnyis med dgyes bskyed pa:

chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pas: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dbyings su bskang: gnyis med bde ba mchog gi gzi byin skyed: byin rlabs nus pa'i mthu dbang bstsal du gsol: hūm̐ hrī: 'og min brdal khyab chen po'i zhing khams nas: kun bzang rigs lnga bsam yas zhi khro'i lha: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: dgongs klong 'du 'bral med pa'i dngos grub stsol: lha klu mi yi zhing khams rab 'byams nas: rigs gsum sems dpa' lha klu mi'i rig 'dzin: brda brgyud tshom bu 'bum sde'i thugs dam bskang: bde stong thig le chen po'i dngos grub stsol: rgya bod zhing khams gnas yul chos 'khor nas: dbang skur rgyud bshad man ngag chu rgyun spel: snyan brgyud grub pa rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang: smin grol 'gro don mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: gsang ba mtha' dag 'dzin pa'i pho brang nas: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi rig pa 'dzin: bcom ldan phyag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang: mthu stobs nus byin 'bar ba'i dngos grub stsol: mkhyen rab ye shes rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi rig pa 'dzin: bcom ldan 'jam dpal dpa' bo'i thugs dam bskang: gzungs dran spobs pa mtha' yas dngos grub stsol: byams chen snying rje'i rang bzhin dkyil 'khor nas: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi rig pa 'dzin: bcom ldan spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs dam bskang: 'gro 'dul thugs rje chen po'i dngos grub stsol: rdo rje sems dpa'i shel gyi khang bu nas: dus gsum bde gshegs ye shes sprul pa'i sku: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang: lha dang rtog pa dbyer med dngos grub stsol: bde chen rdo rje brtsegs pa'i pho brang du: glegs bam dbang thob zung 'jug ye shes sku: skal ldan rgyal po dzaḥyi thugs dam bskang: rgyud lung man ngag chos kyi dngos grub stsol:

theg dgu yongs rdzogs snying po'i ke'u tshang du: rig rtsal dbang thob thig le chen po'i sku: grub mchog shrī siṃ ha'i thugs dam bskang: gnas lugs rtogs pa mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: paṇa chen grub pa lnga brgya'i 'du gnas su: bshes gnyen dbang thob rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku: slob dpon buddha gupta'i thugs dam bskang: sde snod rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: bde gshegs yongs 'dus zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku gsum dbyer med rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i dngos: 'chi med padma thod phreng thugs dam bskang: smin grol ye shes mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: dbus 'gyur bsil tshal gyi dur khrod du: dpal chen yang dag dbyer med ye shes brnyes: slob dpon hūm̐ kā ra yi thugs= 'bru brgyad thig ler rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: sing nga sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod du: 'jam dpal khrag 'thung dbyer med ye shes brnyes: slob dpon mañdzu shrī'i thugs= srid zhi 'khor lo bzhir rdzogs dngos grub stsol: bal yul lhun grub brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du: dbang chen lha dang dbyer med ye shes brnyes: slob dpon nā gārdzu na'i thugs= rdo rje'i rta skad grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: za hor laṅka brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du: rdo rje gzhon nu dbyer med ye shes brnyes: slob dpon pra bha hasti'i thugs= srid pa thal 'byin chen po'i dngos grub stsol: sā la'i gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod du: mngon rdzogs lha dang dbyer med ye shes brnyes: slob dpon dha na saṃskṛ'i thugs= rtsa rlung thig le smin pa'i dngos grub stsol: o rgyan padma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du: che mchog dpal dang dbyer med ye shes brnyes: slob dpon bi ma mi tra'i thugs= snang srid bdud rtsir dag pa'i dngos grub stsol: kha che he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod du: gsang bdag lha dang dbyer med ye shes brnyes:

slob dpon gu hya tsand+ra'i thugs= dregs pa bran du 'khol ba'i dngos grub stsol: li yul laṅka brtsegs pa'i dur khrod du: stobs ldan dpal dang dbyer med ye shes brnyes: slob dpon shīntaṃ garbha'i thugs dam bskang: drag sngags mthu dbang rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: brag phug mā ra ti ka'i gnas mchog tu: 'chi med rdo rje'i sa brnyes zung 'jug sku: lha lcam mandā ra ba'i thugs dam bskang: tshe dang ye shes rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: ti sgro brag dkar mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang du: snang bzhi mthar phyin 'pho med dwangs ma'i sku: bde chen ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs= gzungs dran ting 'dzin rgya mtsho'i dngos grub stsol: dpal gyi bsam yas dbu rtse'i gnas mchog tu: bde 'dus bka' babs rgyun mtha'i ting 'dzin brnyes: chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan thugs= rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus lung gi dngos grub stsol: lho brag mkhar chu dpal gyi phug ring du: yang dag bka' babs nyi ma'i zer la gshegs: gnubs chen nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs= 'od gsal snying po thugs kyi dngos grub stsol: sbrags kyi yang rdzong gsang ba'i phug pa ru: gshin rje'i bka' babs nyi zla gdan tu bting: mthu chen sangs rgyas ye shes thugs= khrag 'thung rol pa sku yi dngos grub stsol: bsam yas mchims phu dpal gyi nags 'dabs su: rta mgrin bka' babs rta skad 'dzam gling khyab: slob dpon rgyal ba mchog dbyangs thugs= dbang chen bzhad pa gsung gi dngos grub stsol: bsam 'grub bde chen shel gyi phug pa ru: che mchog bka' babs brag las bdud rtsi 'beb: gnyags chen ye shes gzhon nu'i thugs= sku dang ye shes yon tan dngos grub stsol: ma mo'i 'du gnas brag dmar ke'u tshang du: phur pa'i bka' babs mkha' la thogs med 'phyo: sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms thugs= bdud bzhi zil gnon phrin las dngos grub stsol: yar stod sham po gangs kyi phug pa ru:

ma mo'i bka' babs srid pa las la bkol: 'brog mi dpal gyi ye shes thugs dam= rbod gtong grub pa sngags kyi dngos grub stsol: stag tshang bsam 'grub seng ge'i phug pa ru: dregs pa'i bka' babs sde brgyad bran du bkol: rlangs chen dpal gyi seng ge'i thugs= gsang ba 'dzin pa stobs kyi dngos grub stsol: 'chi med g.ya' ma lung gi brag phug tu: drag sngags bka' babs kun mkhyen ye shes brnyes: lo chen rnam par snang mdzad thugs= gzung 'dzin tshar gcod mthu yi dngos grub stsol: bod yul sgrub pa'i gnas mchog rab 'byams su: rtsa gsum bka' babs rdzu 'phrul brtul zhugs grub: dus gsum rtsa brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang: las dang ye shes mthar phyin dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: lha dang rtog pa dbyer med dkyil 'khor du: bsnyen sgrub mthar phyin skal ldan rjes su 'dzin: rig 'dzin slob dpon yongs kyi thugs dam bskang: lam lnga sa bcu yongs rdzogs dngos grub stsol: gsang mchog rol pa rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor du: bde chen skur bzhengs rnam 'phrul cir yang ston: yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams thugs= las bzhi grub brgyad mchog gi dngos grub stsol: gnas yul dur khrod gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: zhi chags 'bar ba'i gar sgyur 'phrul po che: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro yongs kyi thugs= tshar gcod rjes 'dzin las kyi dngos grub stsol: phyi nang mtshams 'dzin srung ba'i dkyil 'khor du: tshad med bzhi ldan rnam bzhi'i phrin las mdzad: sgo skyong ging chen yab yum thugs= zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol: bka' dang bstan pa skyong ba'i dkyil 'khor du: dpal gyi dam bzhes phrin las thogs med sgrub: chos srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs= bstan dang der 'dzin rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: thugs dam skong ba'i rmad byung mchod sprin ni: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam 'phrul pa'i:

gling bzhi'i nyer spyod 'dod 'byung yid bzhin gter: phyi mchod nam mkha' gang bas thugs dam bskang: rdo rje'i gzugs mdzes snyan 'gyur brjid pa'i sgra: bdud rtsi'i dri bsung ro brgya'i zhal zas dang: reg bya 'jam 'khril bde chen ye shes skyed: nang mchod srid gsum khyab pas thugs= 'dod chags khrag mtsho zhe sdang rus pa'i ri: gti mug sha chen nga rgyal myos byed rgyun: phrag dog don snod tshom bur brdal ba sogs: dur khrod drag po'i mchod pas thugs= sku gsung thugs kyi bde chen ye shes skyed: yon tan rgyan ldan phrin las glu dbyangs len: gsang mchog padmo bzhad pa'i rnam 'gyur can: rdo rje'i rig ma'i tshogs kyis thugs= lhan skyes ye shes byang chub sems su sbyor: gzung 'dzin rtog pa 'od gsal dbyings su bsgral: zung 'jug 'khor gsum las 'das 'od gsal klong: bla med gsang ba'i mchod pas thugs= snang srid rnam dag bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bskyil: khams gsum stongs byed khrag mtsho lbu phreng 'khrigs: 'dod 'byung dpal gtor lhun po brjid dang ldan: rmad byung dam tshig mchod pas thugs= 'od gsal ye shes mar me'i snang bas khyab: bde mchog sgyu ma'i gdugs 'phan bla bre 'phyang: byang chub khang bzang nor bu'i rgyan ldan sogs: rnam mang bkod pa rgya mtshos thugs= gzhan yang sgrub rdzas gnyan pos gzhi bzung ste: mchod rdzas skong rdzas longs spyod chen por spungs: rten gyi rdzas 'chang bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin gsal: dam tshig longs spyod yongs kyis thugs dam bskang: sku gsung thugs gyur nyams chag rtog sgrib dag: zhi rgyas dbang drag las kun lhun gyis grub: rig 'dzin bzhi dang dbang bcu'i ye shes 'phel: stobs bcu'i rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: hūm̐ hrī: bskang du med de skye med ngang du bskang: mchod du med de gnyis med rol pas mchod: sbyor du med de zung 'jug chen por sbyor:
