sgrol du med de mnyam nyid dbyings su bsgral: ye sbyor ye sgrol chen pos thugs dam bskang: ho: rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang dus gsum bla ma dang: yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro dam can sogs: dpang gyur spyan ldan skyabs mchog ma lus kun: dmigs med thugs rjes bdag la dgongs su gsol: bdag cag thog med dus kyi sngon rol nas: rang ngo ma mthong gzung 'dzin rtog pas bsgribs: 'gro ba drug tu skye ba'i kha brgyud de: las kyi dbang gis bag chags sna tshogs shar: nyon mongs dbang gyur lus ngag yid gsum gyis: sdig pa mi dge'i las rnams ci bsags pa: snying nas 'gyod pas bshags shing bsdam bgyid na: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: nyes spyod spong ba so thar sdom pa dang: dge ba'i chos sdud byang chub bslab pa mchog: thun mong rgyud sde'i rtsa ba yan lag sogs: spyi yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags: bla med gsang mchog rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du: 'da' dka' khas blangs rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang: sbom po'i ltung ba phra mo ji snyed sogs: khyad par dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags: he ru ka dpal sgrub pa'i spyod pa mchog: dgongs te gsungs pa'i brtul zhugs nyi shu dang: gsang bar 'os dang gnyer gtad la sogs pa: lhag pa'i dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags: dbang thob yi dam zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor gyi: phyag rgya ma gsal bying rgod dbang du gyur: bkod pa'i lha dang phyag mtshan ston pa sogs: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags: rdo rje'i gsang sngags bsnyen cing sgrub pa g.yel: bzlas pa'i skyon gyis byin rlabs nus pa yal: sngags kyi snyems pas phra mo'i las la bkol: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags: rtog pa'i dbang gis gnas lugs don ma mthong: le lo'i dbang gyur mnyam gzhag sgom pa g.yel: gzung 'dzin mtshan mas spyod pa dngos por gol: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol zhing bshags:

sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag sogs: sdom dang dam tshig nyams chag 'gal 'khrul kun: mi 'chab mi sbed bshags shing bsdam bgyid na: dag cing tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: don dam bshags dang bshags bya las 'das kyang: kun rdzob sgyu ma'i nyams sgrib byang zhing dag: rdo rje gsang ba mchog gi ye shes dang: dbyer med sku gsung thugs su lhun grub shog:

brkyang phyag 'tshal zhing yig brgya bzla: rig stong gnyug mar mnyam bzhag pas: bskal par bsags pa'i sdig ltung yang: skad cig nyid la byang bar nges: de ltar skong bshags rim pa 'di: dus drug rtse gcig brtson pa yis: sngags 'chang dam tshig rnam dag pas: rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis rlob: yi dam lha yis dngos grub ster: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros grogs mdzad nas: nang gi sa lam myur bgrod 'gyur: tha ma bsgral zhing bstab pa ni: hūm̐: 'bar ba chen po'i phyag rgya rnam bzhi yis: 'jig rten kun gyi log 'dren dgra bgegs tshogs: dgug bstim bcing zhing chos nyid ngang du myos: ma rungs bsgral ba'i zhing du mngon gyur cig: e nṛ tri sarba sha trūn bighnān dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐: dpal chen khros pa'i las mdzad he ru ka'i: gzi brjid stobs kyis tshe bsod sgrub la bstim: byang sems stobs kyis gnas kyi dri ma sbyang: ye shes stobs kyis rnam shes dbyings su sbyor: drag shul stobs kyis gzugs phung tshogs su bsgral: sha khrag rus gsum dgyes pa'i longs spyod rdzas: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rab 'byams zhal du stob: khams gsum yongs sgrol brtul zhugs mthar phyin nas: bde chen ye shes rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol: shrī he ru ka badzra kī li kī la ya sarba sha trūn bighnān hūm̐ a mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra sarba sha trūn bighnān ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi: ha ha hi hi he he hūm̐ hūm̐: nang gi dkyil 'khor dgyes pa'i phyir: dam tshig rdzas kyi longs spyod 'bul: ho: rdo rje'i dam tshig chen po ni: spang len mnyam pa'i brtul zhugs rdzas: rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i longs spyod mchog: dgyes pa mchog gis bzhes su gsol: ho: rdo rje bza' ba'i dam tshig rdzas: bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud:

phung khams lha dang mnyam sbyor ba'i: mchod pa'i phyag rgya chen por blang: ma hā pū dza sa ma ya ātma ko3 haṃ: ho: bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gtso mchog thod phreng rtsal: gsal brtan ting 'dzin ye shes dkyil 'khor dbus: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan gzhal med khang: bde chen ye shes sgyu ma'i bkod pa rdzogs: spyi bor dgongs brgyud bde gshegs mkha' khyab bzhugs: mgrin par brda brgyud rig 'dzin dgongs nyams bskyang: snying khar rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje chos: dpal chen grub pa'i slob dpon tshogs kyis bskor: lte bar snyan brgyud rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang: gsang gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i sprin phung 'phro: gzhan yang phung khams skye mched thams cad kun: rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs til gyi gong bu ltar: snang stong chu zla lta bur gsal ba yi: lag gnyis thabs shes rdo rje'i dgang blugs kyis: bza' bca' btung ba bla med dam tshig rdzas: lha dang dbyer med dgyes bzhad zhal du 'bul: gtum mo'i me yis bzhu btul byang chub sems: yul dang dbang po gnyis med bde ba che: chos nyid khyab brdal chen po'i mchod sprin gyis: dgyes mnyam mchog gi ye shes mngon gyur shog: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra su kha saṃ bho ga dzñā na ātma ko3 haṃ: de ltar ting 'dzin gsal btab nas: zhen med ngang nas tshims par rol: phyi nang skye mched lha yi tshogs: mnyes phyir rdo rje'i glu gar bya: oṃ hūm̐: gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na: rtsa gsum lha tshogs rtag tu bzhugs: snang srid gzhir bzhengs ye shes kyis: snod bcud dam tshig phyag rgyar bzhengs: kā ya dzñā na a la la ho: te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐: ti pu ma hā su kha a haṃ: skye zhing gnas dang sdud pa'i rlung: sngags kyi sgra dbyangs 'du 'bral med: rnal 'byor drod dang bde ba yis: kha sbyor dbu ma'i srog tu bzhengs: wā ka dzñā na a la la ho: te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐: ti pu ma hā su kha a haṃ:

rab dgyes chos kyi 'byung gnas ma: bde chen mchog gis lhag par brgyan: rmad byung 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal gyis: zag med lhan skyes thig ler bzhengs: tsitta dzñā na a la la ho: te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐: ti pu ma hā su kha a haṃ: 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das: thams cad ka dag gnyug ma'i dbyings: rig rtsal 'gag med ye shes kyis: lhun rdzogs 'od gsal rgyan du bzhengasaḥ badzra dzñā na a la la ho: te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐: ti pu ma hā su kha a haṃ: rdo rje rtag pa rgyun gyi glu: ye shes nyi ma'i sgra dbyangs can: padma gar gyi las byas pas: thams cad phyag rgya'i 'khor lor rdzogs: ma hā dzñā na gīrti a la la ho: te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐: ti pu ma hā su kha a haṃ: rta mchog dpal gyi bde ba'i dbyangs: rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes can: he ru ka dpal dgyes pa'i gar: 'khor 'das kun gyi srog tu grub: badzra satwa dzñā na gīrti a la la ho: te na hūm̐ te na hūm̐: ti pu ma hā su kha a haṃ: skye ba med la 'gag pa med: gnas med len med rten dang bral: thams cad ye shes phyag rgya'i rgyan: lhun grub chen po'i thig ler 'khyil: dhā tu dzñā na a la la ho: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wā ka tsitta dzñā na gu ṇa karma ma hā shūn+ya tā ma hā su kha ma hā dzñā na dhā tu ātma ko3 haṃ: 'a buddha dzñā na sa ma ya ho: a badzra dzñā na sa ma ya st+waṃ: sa ratna dzñā na a nu rā ga ya ho: sha padma dzñā na a nu rā ga yā mi: ma karma dzñā na dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: ha he ru ka dzñā na ma hā su kha a ti bi shuddha dzñā na a haṃ: bkra shis gang zhig rtag pa'i ye shes rdo rje sems: nyi ma'i stobs rdzogs padma dgyes pa'i zhal mnga' bas: a haṃ rdo rje rta yi mgrin glus he ru ka: dga' ba chen pos khams gsum rtag tu rol gyur cig: gsang ba'i glu 'di sus blangs pa: he ru ka yang thugs 'phrog na: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lta ci smos: mthong thos dran reg thams cad kun:

rdo rje sems dpas dbugs dbyung nas: bde chen mchog gi byin phebs te: tshe 'di nyid la grol bar nges: gsang ba snyoms 'jug tshogs 'khor gyis: lhan skyes ye shes 'phel ba'i phyir: drod thob spyod pa dngos su brtsam: rjes mthun ting 'dzin cho gas bsgrub: ho: sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig bla na med: bde mchog sgyu ma'i 'byung gnas lha mo che: dgyes shing 'dzum pa'i mdangs ldan padma la: byang chub sems sprin dbab phyir dang du blang: pra dzñā mu dra sa ma ya ātma ko3 haṃ: ho: bdag nyid thabs kyi ye shes thod phreng rtsal: phyag rgya shes rab sgyu ma mandā ra: mkha' gsang bde chen rdo rje padma'i 'dzum: hūm̐ dang āḥyis mtshan pa'i 'od zer gyis: zhi khro rab 'byams spyan drangs dbyer med thim: bde ba mchog gi ye shes byin chen phebs: gang shar bde ba'i sgyu rtsal rmad byung bas: sangs rgyas byang chub mngon du bya ba'i phyir: brda dang lan gyis bskul ba'i dam tshig gis: phyag rgya bzhi ldan rol pas snyoms par zhugs: gsor dang bskyod pa'i rjes chags chen po'i mes: byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gnas lngar babs: phung khams skye mched rtsa gsum lha tshogs kun: dgyes pa chen po'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar: 'dzag med bzung zhing gyen du ldog pa dang: gnas su bkram pa'i lhan skyes dga' ba bzhi: thams cad shin tu rnam dag 'od gsal ngang: zung 'jug kha sbyor longs spyod chen por rol: oṃ padma badzra mandā ra a haṃ: badzra padma hūm̐ ā: ma hā su kha kā ma gu ṇa ho: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ: a nu rā ga ho: a nu rā ga yā mi: badzra sparshe dza: badzra kle ṣa hūm̐: badzra bandha baṃ: badzra ā be sha ho: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu rā ga ṇa dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: bdud rtsi lnga ni snying gar byugs: sha chen bza' zhing brtul zhugs bskyed: mthar thug de kho na nyid kyi: ye shes ngang du mnyam par bzhag:

a: gdod nas rnam dag rig stong rdzogs pa che: gnas lugs don gyi bla ma rtsa gsum lha: rang bzhin yongs shes ngang du mnyam gzhag pa'i: mchod pa chen pos rtag tu mnyes gyur cig: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā dzñā na pū dza ātma ko3 haṃ: dharma dhā tu a a: de ltar bsod nams ye shes kyi: tshogs kyi mchod pa'i 'bras bu che: myur du 'grub pa'i smon lam ni: rtse gcig gdung bas 'di ltar gdab: ho: snang srid dag pa rab 'byams dkyil 'khor du: longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba yis: bum dbang dam tshig nyams chag byang zhing dag: snang stong phyag rgya'i ye shes myur 'grub shog: rdo rje lus kyi phung po'i dkyil 'khor du: dam rdzas tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba yis: gsang dbang dam tshig nyams chag byang zhing dag: gsal stong bde ba'i ye shes myur 'grub shog: shes rab phyag rgya'i padma'i dkyil 'khor du: byang sems tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba yis: sher dbang dam tshig nyams chag byang zhing dag: bde stong lhan skyes ye shes myur 'grub shog: chos dbyings mtha' dang bral ba'i dkyil 'khor du: rig rtsal tshogs kyi mchod pa phul ba yis: tshig dbang dam tshig nyams chag byang zhing dag: dbyings rig zung 'jug ye shes myur 'grub shog: snang srid thams cad padma drwa ba'i zhing: snod bcud ma lus bde chen tshogs kyi rgyan: shes dang shes bya ro gcig 'khor lo'i ngang: 'chi med rtsa gsum go 'phang 'grub gyur cig: phyi yi tshogs kyis nyams chag skong: dngos grub 'dod rgu myur du 'grub: nang gi tshogs kyis rtsa rlung 'byongs: thig le las su rung bar 'phel: gsang ba'i tshogs kyis 'pho chags dag: zag med bde ba'i ye shes rgyas: de kho na nyid tshogs chen pos: don gyi lhan skyes mngon du 'gyur: de phyir rdo rje theg pa yi: gsang ba'i kun spyod rmad byung ba: rig 'dzin yongs kyi khyad par dang: rgyun gyi nyams len snying po yin:

de ltar dngos sam rjes mthun pa'i: tshogs kyi spyod pa mthar phyin nas: gtsang sme'i lhag gtor so sor bsham: bdud rtsis 'thor zhing kha phru dbab: hūm̐ hrī: dam tshig lhag ma 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i sprin: he ru ka dpal kha chu'i 'od zer 'phro: kun tu bzang po'i ye shes bdud rtsi mchog: rmad du byung ba'i dam rdzas chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrī: hūm̐ hrī: dpal chen khrag 'thung rol pa'i gnas bcu dang: dur khrod brgyad sogs dbang drag zhing rnams nas: ye shes 'jig rten las kyi tshul bzung ba'i: lhag mgron dam tshig can rnams 'dir gshegs shig: ma ma dhā ka dhā ki nī dzñā na lo ka karma sarba sa ma ya e ā ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ pheṃ pheṃ: hūm̐ hrī: shar nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngon mo 'bum: zhal zas tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di bzhes la: mi 'gyur rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog: nad gdon bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: lho nas rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo 'bum: zhal zas tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di bzhes la: rngam brjid rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: nub nas padma mkha' 'gro dmar mo 'bum: zhal zas tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di bzhes la: rjes chags rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog: khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i phrin las mdzod: byang phyogs las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang mo 'bum: zhal zas tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di bzhes la: drag gtum rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog: mi mthun dgra bgegs tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: dbus nas bde gshegs mkha' 'gro dkar mo 'bum: zhal zas tshogs kyi longs spyod 'di bzhes la: 'phrul bzhad rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsun ma zlog: mchog gi spyod pa grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: pañtsa dzñā na dhā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: phud lhag gcig tu bsres byas la:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ dzñā na karma u tstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta hūm̐ ha hoḥhrī: hūm̐ bhyo: dang po phud kyis rtsa gsum dgyes pa bskangs: bar du longs spyod rnal 'byor rgyan du rol: tha ma lhag la dbang ba'i tshogs rnams kun: dpal gyi pham phab zhal zas 'di bzhes shig: mkha' 'gro so gnyis rigs lnga'i kiṅka ra: sum brgya drug cu rigs kyi pho nya mo: ma bdun sring bzhi mgyogs ma spor ma'i tshogs: snang srid gnas yul kun tu khyab pa yi: dpa' bo rngams brjid gad rgyangs ya la la: dpa' mo rjes chags bshug glu kyu ru ru: pho nya las mkhan skar ltar khyugs se khyug: thams cad rdo rje'i dam tshig la gnas pas: sha khrag bdud rtsi lhag ma'i longs spyod rol: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor rnams kyi bar chad zlog: bsgrub pa'i gnas srungs bgegs tshogs tshar thag chod: bsgrub rdzas srid zhi'i 'dod yon bcud du phob: bsgrub pa'i ting 'dzin 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod: ma ma lo ka pañtsa dhā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: bshal chu bdud rtsi'i rgyun du spel: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥbhyo: gzhan yang mi srun las kyi pho nya mo: 'jig rten kun nyul ging 'gong rlung shugs 'chang: 'jigs pa'i skur ston rngam pa'i mgo brnyan can: nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang khyab pa kun: rtsa gsum zhal zas bdud rtsi'i bshal chu bzhes: dpal gyi dam tshig gnyan po rjes dgongs la: 'khor srungs rkyen zlog 'dod rgu'i bsam pa sgrubs: 'jig rten khams kun bde ba'i phrin las mdzod: sarba karma dhā ki nī pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ ta khā hi: mkha' 'gro ma yi lhag chog tshul: gzhan du ma bstan gdams pa 'dis: rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i bar chad zhi: phrin las thogs med myur 'grub 'gyur: gnyis pa bskul gyi las rim la: dang po ye shes thugs dam bskul: hūm̐ hrī: sku gsum zhing khams rab 'byams thams cad nas: bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:

sngon gyi dus nas g.yar dam bzhes pa ltar: thugs rje chen po'i phrin las dus la bab: rdo rje gsum gyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol: lus ngag yid la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: 'og min gsang ba chen po'i gzhal yas nas: kun bzang rigs lnga zhi khro rab 'byams lha: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma dbyings nas bzhengs: skye med chos skur smin pa'i phrin las mdzod: lha gnas gsum sogs sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: rigs gsum sems dpa' skal ldan 'dus pa'i tshogs: rig 'dzin brda brgyud bla ma dbyings nas bzhengs: 'gag med longs skur rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: gnas yul dur khrod grub pa'i pho brang nas: gang 'dul thabs kyis 'gro rnams drang mdzad pa: dus gsum snyan brgyud bla ma dbyings nas bzhengs: gnas med sprul skur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: stobs bcu'i nus pas bdud sde'i dpung tshogs btul: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i bdag po dbyings nas bzhengs: byin rlabs nus rtsal 'bar ba'i phrin las mdzod: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yi dkyil 'khor nas: ye shes snang bas 'gro ba'i mun pa sel: rig 'dzin 'jam dpal gzhon nu dbyings nas bzhengs: mkhyen gnyis gter chen brdol ba'i phrin las mdzod: sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas: thugs rje chen pos khams gsum dbugs chen 'byin: rig 'dzin spyan ras gzigs dbang dbyings nas bzhengs: snying rje'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: yi dam lha dang dbyer med dkyil 'khor nas: bde chen rdo rje sems dpa'i gdung 'tshob che: rig 'dzin dga' rab dpa' bo dbyings nas bzhengs: rtog tshogs lha skur smin pa'i phrin las mdzod: rgyud lung glegs bam 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor nas:

gsang chen bla na med pa'i shing rta che: rig 'dzin ind+ra bhū ti dbyings nas bzhengs: rgyal kun gsung la dbang thob phrin las mdzod: rig rtsal 'gag med 'od kyi dkyil 'khor nas: 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i shing rta che: rig 'dzin shrī siṃ ha dbyings nas bzhengs: thugs kyi dgongs don rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: bshes gnyen 'khor los sgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sde snod rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i slob dpon che: rig 'dzin sangs rgyas gsang ba dbyings nas bzhengs: bslab gsum rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: sku gsum zhing khams rgya mtsho'i ngo bo nyid: dpal ri padma 'od kyi gzhal med khang: ye shes 'od zer bkod pa bkrag tu 'tsher: rtsa gsum rab 'byams 'du gnas byin re che: dpa' bo pho tshogs mchod sprin bag re dro: dpa' mo rig ma'i glu gar nyams re dga': chos skyong dregs pa'i gtum rngam brjid re che: dpe med bsam brjod las 'das dkyil 'khor nas: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las lhun grub 'dus pa'i dpal: rigs rnams kun gyi khyab bdag che ba'i mchog: o rgyan ma hā gu ru dbyings nas bzhengs: bod khams sdug bsngal drag pos nyam thag tshe: rje btsun khyed las skyabs gzhan ma mchis pas: thugs rje nus pa'i rtsal shugs sprug tu gsol: sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'di la byin chen phob: ngo mtshar rtags dang mtshan ma myur du ston: sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bde gsal mi rtog ye shes mngon sum skyed: byang chub sgrub pa'i bgegs tshogs rdul du rlog: log 'dren 'byung po'i bar chad zil gyis non: thun mong phrin las rnam bzhi'i rten 'brel sgrigs: rig 'dzin grub pa'i gseng lam la brten nas: mchog gi dngos grub sku lnga ye shes dbyings: khams gsum 'gro kun grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī:

yang dag khrag 'thung rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin hūm̐ chen kā ra sku bzhengs shig: 'bru brgyad gser phreng 'od 'bar klong yangs su: gzhi 'bras rtsal chen rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: zil gnon gshin rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin mañdzu mi tra sku bzhengs shig: rang byung 'khor lo rnam bzhi'i cho 'phrul gyis: 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: dbang chen padma rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin nā gārdzu na sku bzhengs shig: rta skad thengs gsum rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs kyis: srid gsum ka nas dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: bde chen che mchog rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin bi ma mi tra sku bzhengs shig: snang srid bdud rtsir 'khyil pa'i bcud chen pos: 'gro 'dul grol ba bzhi ldan phrin las mdzod: mngon spyod phur pa rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin pra bha hasti sku bzhengs shig: thal 'byin bzhi ldan badzra kī la ya'i: rnam bzhi'i grub mtha' snyogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: bde mchog mngon rdzogs rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin dha na saṃskṛ sku bzhengs shig: las dang 'jig rten ye shes ma mo'i tshogs: rtsa rlung thig ler dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: gtum chen dregs 'dul rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin gu hya tsand+ra sku bzhengs shig: stong srog rang rig chos skur lhun rdzogs pas: khams gsum dregs pa zil gnon phrin las mdzod: drag sngags stobs ldan rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: rig 'dzin shāntiṃ garbha sku bzhengs shig: rdzong 'phrang srog gsum dmod pa'i rtsal chen pos: gzung 'dzin log 'dren tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: bde mchog bde spyod nye rgyu'i dkyil 'khor du: zag pa gsum zad mi shigs rdo rje'i sku: 'chi med mandā ra ba dbyings nas bzhengs: tshe dang ye shes rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: bde stong zung 'jug thig le'i dkyil 'khor du:

gzungs dran mngon shes ting 'dzin rgya mtsho brnyes: bde chen ye shes mtsho rgyal dbyings nas bzhengs: lhan skyes rang rtsal rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: tshom bu dgu ldan rol pa'i dkyil 'khor du: yi dam lha dang dbyer med dngos grub brnyes: bka' babs rje 'bangs rnam dgu dbyings nas bzhengs: ye shes klong dgur grol ba'i phrin las mdzod: rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus snying po'i dkyil 'khor du: dbang bskur lung bstan byin rlabs nus rtsal 'byongs: rnal 'byor dbang phyug tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: mchog thun grub pa rgya mtsho'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ldan dkyil 'khor du: rnam smin tshe dbang phyag rgyar lhun grub pa'i: rig 'dzin slob dpon tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: dgongs pas byin gyis brlab pa'i phrin las mdzod: zhi khro 'bar ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: dgyes pa'i gar mdzad bde chen gzi byin 'bar: rab 'byams yi dam lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: dngos grub char bzhin 'beb pa'i phrin las mdzod: phyi dang nang gi gnas yul dur khrod du: rnal 'byor grogs mdzad bde stong ye shes spel: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: nye rgyu'i spyod pa grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs kyi sgo bzhi nas: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs: sgo srung pho nya rnam bzhi dbyings nas bzhengs: zhi rgyas dbang drag las kyi phrin las mdzod: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po'i dkyil 'khor du: legs nyes stangs 'dzin bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: brgyud gsum chos srung tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: bshad sgrub bstan pa dar ba'i phrin las mdzod: o rgyan chen po'i bka' yi gnyer 'dzin cing: zab mo'i chos dang sbas gnas gnyan po skyong: gter bdag srung ma rgya mtsho dbyings nas bzhengs: zab gter bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod:

hūm̐ hrī: rje btsun gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i sprin phung 'phro: thugs kyi dgongs pa mkha' ltar rnam par dag: ye shes rol pa'i cho 'phrul bsam mi khyab: yi dam lha tshogs zhi khro'i nyams 'gyur ston: dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bde ba'i gar thabs sgyur: chos srung pho nya'i tshogs rnams las la myur: thugs dam dus la bab bo gzi byin skyed: bdag cag sgrub mchog rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi: sdang ba'i dgra thul gnod pa'i bgegs tshogs choms: sa dang lam gyi bar chad dbyings su sol: mchog thun grub pa rgya mtsho'i phrin las mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la sa pa ri bā ra dzñā na a dhiṣṭhā na siddhi karma sarba sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐:

zhes bskul dgongs pa'i gding bskyed pas: rtsa gsum rab 'byams lha tshogs kyi: sku sngags phyag rgya'i cho 'phrul gyis: mchog thun las kun lhun grub bsam: de nas 'jig rten skyong ba rnams: mchod cing tha tshig bsgrag pa'i phyir: bdag nyid he ru ka dpal dang: dbyer med ting 'dzin rtsal bskyed la: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod drag po'i zhing: phyi nang gsang mchod 'dod yon char bzhin 'beb: skong rdzas rten rdzas mthun pa'i rdzas la sogs: bkod pa rab rdzogs nam mkha'i mdzod du shar: oṃ sarba bitpū ra pū ra su ra su ra ā brta ā brta ho: badzra spha ra ṇa khaṃ: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: 'od gsal snying rje'i ye shes 'bar ba'i 'phrul: dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khang chen dbus: rtsibs brgyad 'khor lo'i lte bar pad nyi dang: dgra bgegs bsnol cing me rlung 'khrugs pa'i klong: rdo rje srin po ma ning stobs kyi bdag: mthing nag ru mtshon gdengs shing snying phreng 'chang: dar nag ber gsol beng chen sked par btsug: khro bo'i chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis 'dor thabs 'gying: g.yas su pho rgyud gtso bo legs ldan nag: g.yon du mo rgyud tshogs rje ral gcig ma: mdun du sku yi mgon po stag la zhon: rgyab tu gsung gi mgon po phyag drug pa: shar lhor thugs kyi mgon po gri gug can: lho nub yon tan mgon po rnam thos sras: nub byang ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa: byang shar phrin las mgon po stobs 'phrog dbang: de yi phyi rol khrag mtsho 'khrugs pa'i klong: shar lhor lha yi mgon po dbang phyug che: lho nub gza' yi mgon po rā hu la: nub byang bdud kyi mgon po trakshad nag: byang shar gnod sbyin mgon po bdud 'dul dbang: sgo bzhir rdo rje legs pa btsan 'gong tshogs: zhing skyong seng gdong gnas yul skyong ba'i 'khor: klu yi srin po klu gnyan sa bdag dpung:

dur khrod ma mo brtan ma skyong mar bcas: kun kyang stong nyid ngang las 'bar ba'i tshul: rigs kyi cho 'phrul sprul pa bsam yas 'gyed: he ru ka dpal pho nya chen por gsal: phyi 'khor dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad du: dbang phyug nyer brgyad ging bdud rtsis bshan dang: dmus long khyi 'brug ce spyang 'bar ma brgyad: dam can bcu gnyis ming po mang po'i tshogs: gtum zhing drag shul lha srin sde brgyad dpung: bar mtshams sde dpon dregs chen ging laṅka: ma mo mkha' 'gro sha za 'bum sde'i tshogs: gtso dang 'khor bcas mngon sum gsal ba la: bdag nyid dpal chen thugs ka'i sa bon las: 'od zer lcags kyus dbyings nas spyan drangs thim: hūm̐ bhyo: he ru ka dpal chen po'i gdung 'tshob phyir: dad pa dam tshig dbang gis rgyud bskul na: dpal ldan mgon po bstan srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: glog ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis da tshur byon: oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ngharma pā la sa pa ri bā ra badzra sa ma ya dzaḥdza: hūm̐ bhyo: dur khrod drag po me rlung 'khrugs pa'i dbus: rngam brjid stobs ldan rdo rje srin po che: rgyud gsum dregs pa rgya mtsho'i dpung dang bcas: bstan pa bsrung phyir dgyes bzhin bzhugs su gsol: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥtiṣṭha lhan: badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ: a ti pū ho: pra tītstsha ho: hūm̐ bhyo: dngos su bshams dang yid las byung ba yi: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i drag po'i mchod sprin dang: sman gtor rakta byang chub sems chen pos: dpal mgon lcam dral 'khor bcas mnyes gyur cig: oṃ shrī badzra ma hā kā la ngharma pā la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā ru dra arghaṃ pādyaṃ puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai bi dyā shabda pū dza ho: pañtsa a mṛta ma hā rakta ma hā ba liṃ ta ga ṇa gu hya pū dza ho: khyad par gtor ma'i mchod pa ni: sha lnga bdud rtsi ye shes lnga: bdud rtsi dgra bgegs sha rus khrag: dgyes mchod chen por bzhes par bsam:

oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ga ṇa gu hya sa pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: oṃ bhu ru ku ru u tsuṣma sa pa ri bā ra= ma ma e ka dzā ṭi sa pa ri= oṃ ma hā kā la rū pa= oṃ ma hā kā la kṣiṃ kṣe tra pā la= oṃ shrī ma hā kā la= oṃ bai trag raksha bhyo= oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da= oṃ ma hā kā la bi kā la= oṃ ma hā de ba dza hriṃ= oṃ raksha rā hu la= oṃ ma hā kā la trakshad bhyo= oṃ ma hā kā la ratna tsitta= tri badzra sā dhu= bhyo siṃ ha mu kha= ya nā ga raksha= bhyo ma ma ra li= oṃ shrī badzra dharma pā la sa ma ya bhyo hrīḥdzaḥdzwa la dhā ti rakṣa hrī aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs pa ri bā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: ji ltar rigs pas phul ba'i mthar: thugs dam bskang zhing bstod pa ni: hūm̐ bhyo: khrag 'thung gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod che: rngam brjid stobs ldan drag po'i pho brang 'dir: 'jigs rung rjes chags bkod pa bsam yas pas: dam can 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig: dgra bgegs bsgral pa'i dbang po'i me tog dang: gsur chen bdug pa zhun chen mar gyi me: mkhris pa'i dri chab sha khrag rus pa'i zas: rkang gling drag po'i rol mos thugs dam bskang: zhing gi bla bre rgyu rlon lda ldi 'phyar: ro skra'i rnga yab don snying 'phan tshar bkram: rkang lag shar bu mgo bo'i tshom bus spras: brjid ldan dpal gyi 'byor pas thugs dam bskang: ri rab gling bzhi rol mtsho lcags rir bcas: lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rgya mtshos gang: rin chen nor bu'i lhun po rgyan phreng sogs: rmad du byung ba'i bkod pas thugs dam bskang: bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtsho 'khyil li li: dmar chen rakta'i rba rlabs phyu ru ru: dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor chen spungs se spung: mchog gi longs spyod rdzas kyis thugs dam bskang: sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi: rten pa'i rdzas bsham sgrub pa'i phyag rgya bkram:

dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas ma tshang med pa yis: bsnyen sgrub dam tshig chen pos thugs dam bskang: dam can 'khor bcas thugs dam gnyan po bskang: rnal 'byor dam tshig nyams chag mthol lo bshags: rtse gcig mos pas dpal gyi gdung 'tshob phyir: he ru ka yi phrin las myur 'grub mdzod: hūm̐ bhyo: gnyis med ye shes ma ning gsang ba'i bdag: thabs kyi phyag rgya legs ldan tshogs kyi bdag: shes rab dbyings yum sngags srung ral gcig ma: rgyud gsum dregs pa'i gtso la phyag 'tshal bstod: he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i sku gsung thugs: yon tan ye shes phrin las rtsal shar ba: lha dang dbyer med bstan srung mthu bo che: dpal ldan mgon po'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dod khams lha dang gza' gdong sde brgyad tshogs: bdud dang gtum po gnod sbyin gter gyi bdag: kun kyang dbang phyug mthu stobs bsam mi khyab: dregs pa'i ded dpon bzhi la phyag 'tshal bstod: gsang ba'i gnyer 'dzin rdo rje legs pa che: zhing rnams skyong mdzad mthu ldan zab gter srung: drag shul klu srin dur khrod gnas kyi bdag: ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dpal gyi bka' sdod mthu stobs glog ltar myur: rig 'dzin bka' nyan bcol pa'i las kun sgrub: rdo rje'i tha tshig mi g.yel thugs dam can: phyi nang dregs pa'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: mnga' dbang gsol zhing las bcol phyir: sbyar ba'i spos bdug ru mtshon phyar: brjid ldan dbyangs dang rol mo'i sgra: lta sgom dgongs pa'i gding bskyed la: hūm̐ bhyo: kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ka: gdul bya'i snang ngor dregs pa'i gtso bor bzhengs: ma 'gag rol rtsal rnam 'phrul bsam mi khyab: 'od gsal chos kyi sku ru mnga' gsol lo: zhi ba'i dbyings las 'bar ba chen po'i 'phrul: kha sbyor bde ba'i thig ler 'du 'bral med: ye shes yon tan stobs bcu'i shugs 'chang ba: zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs skur mnga' gsol lo:

rgyal ba'i bstan srung mi mthun zhi bar mdzad: dbang bcu'i dpal skyed khams gsum g.yo zhing 'gugs: khyad par 'dul thabs drag shul mi bzad ston: gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku ru mnga' gsol lo: dam can 'khor bcas che ba'i yon tan la: bstod cing mnga' gsol chen pos gzi byin skyed: thogs med las kyi brtul zhugs gnyer gtad na: phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe dgongs brgyud zhi khro rab 'byams dang: bar du brda brgyud rig 'dzin slob dpon che: tha mar dus gsum snyan brgyud bla ma yis: ji ltar bka' bsgos g.yar dam bzhes pa bzhin: chos skyong bstan srung rgya mtsho las la bzhengs: pho rgyud mgon pos rngam pa'i gzi byin skyed: mo rgyud ma mos dbang drag sgyu 'phrul ston: gnyis med rdo rje srin po'i dgongs pa yis: khams gsum dregs pa thams cad zil gyis non: dam rdzas rgyan gyi mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: nad gdon 'jigs brgyad bar chad zhi ba dang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor rigs rgyud 'khor slob spel: snod bcud legs pa'i yon tan dbang du sdus: nyes pa'i rkyen dang glo bur bar chad zlog: bstan la 'tshe ba'i ma rungs dgra bgegs dang: byang chub sgrub la bar chad bdud sde'i dpung: drag shul chen po'i rol pas tshar bcad nas: sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du: rig 'dzin slob dpon rnams kyi dgongs pa'i gding: rgyud lung man ngag bshad sgrub 'phel ba dang: grub brnyes bye bas 'jig rten khams kun khyab: nad mug dug mtshon dus kyi rgud pa zhi: bde skyid dpal gyis 'tsho ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces brjod gtor ma gnas su stob: de ltar srung ma spyir bskul nas: bye brag tha tshig bsgrag pa ni: sha khrag gtor ma bsham zhing bsngo: bka' nan rdo rje'i g.yar dam bsgrag: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: shrī badzra dharma pā la e dzaḥbhyo: i daṃ ba liṃ ta bhuñdza ho:

hūm̐ hrī: nga ni dus gsum rig 'dzin thams cad kyi: dgongs pa'i gdung 'tshob gsang ba'i brtul zhugs 'chang: padma thod phreng rtsal dang dbyer med phyir: 'jig rten dregs pa thams cad las la 'dus: hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe 'og min khyab brdal pho brang du: kun bzang che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams kyis: dgongs pa dbyings kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i rang snang srung ma kun: dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bhyo: bar du lha klu mi yi 'du gnas su: rigs gsum sems dpa' tshom bu 'bum phrag gis: brda thabs du mas chos sgo dbye ba'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i srung ma kun: dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bde chen ye shes rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bhyo: tha ma rgya bod grub pa'i gnas rnams su: snyan brgyud mdzod 'chang slob dpon tshogs rnams kyis: gsang sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa skyong ba'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i dregs pa thams cad kun: dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: snod bcud dbang du bsdu ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ bhyo: da lta bkra shis byin chags sgrub gnas 'dir: ma hā gu ru'i phrin las gdung 'tshob phyir: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor gnyan po'i zhal phyes tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mi mthun dgra bgegs tshar gcod phrin las mdzod: de ltar phrin las spyir gsol nas: bye brag slob dpon che rnams kyi: tha tshig gnyan po bskul ba ni: so so'i dgongs pa'i gding bskyed la: hūm̐ hūm̐: rdo rje sems dpa'i shel gyi khang bu ru: slob dpon chen po dga' rab rdo rje yis: rig pa ye shes 'od kyi skur bzhengs tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: a ti'i sgrub brgyud 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod:

hūm̐ hrī: bde chen rdo rje brtsegs pa'i pho brang du: skal ldan rgyal po ind+ra bhū ti yis: tant+ra bco brgyad chos kyi mdzod brnyes tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rgyud lung bshad sgrub rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: rdo rje gdan gnas theg pa'i pho brang du: rig 'dzin chen po shrī siṃ ha yis: rig rtsal dbang thob snang srid dbang bsdus tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: snying po'i rgyud 'dzin 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: kha che'i yul gyi rab snang gnas mchog tu: paṇa grub chen po sangs rgyas gsang ba ches: sde snod rgyud sde gtan la phab pa'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod bsil ba tshal gyi gnas mchog tu: slob dpon chen po rdo rje hūm̐ kā ras: 'bru brgyad dgongs pa'i gding chen mngon gyur tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mchog gi ye shes 'phel ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod sku la rdzogs pa'i gnas mchog tu: slob dpon chen po mañdzu mi tra yis: 'khor lo rnam bzhi'i brtul zhugs grub pa'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: zil gnon mngon spyod rol pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod lhun grub brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: slob dpon chen po nā gārdzu na yis: rta skad thengs gsum 'dzam gling bsgrags pa'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbang chen dgyes pa gar gyi phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod laṅka brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu:

slob dpon chen po pra bha hasti yis: thal 'byin rnam bzhis mchog thun grub pa'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: srid pa phur bur grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i gnas mchog tu: slob dpon chen po dha na saṃskṛtas: rtsa rlung thig le dbu mar bstims pa'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyir zlog rbod gtong grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod padma brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: slob dpon chen po bi ma mi tra yis: ye shes bdud rtsi bcud du len pa'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: spong len rtog pa dag pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod he chen brdal ba'i gnas mchog tu: slob dpon chen po gu hya tsand+ra yis: srid gsum dregs tshogs zil gyis mnan pa'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bka' gnyan byin che myur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hrī: dur khrod lo ka brtsegs pa'i gnas mchog tu: slob dpon chen po shāntiṃ garbha yis: rdzong 'phrang srog gi ye shes brnyes pa'i tshe: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma thams cad kun: mthun rdzas 'dod yon gtor ma 'di bzhes la: drag po'i mthu dbang rdzogs pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐ hūm̐: yul gyi ming ni o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul: dha na ko ṣa bde chen mtsho gling du: snang ba mtha' yas ye shes sgyu ma'i sku: padma thod phreng rdo rje drag po rtsal: sku gsum dbyer med 'od kyi skur bzhengs tshe: dhā ki'i sngags kyis gnas gsum mkha' 'gro 'dus: dbang drag skad kyis sa gsum 'byung po bkug: ye shes dgongs pa'i phyag rgyas zil gyis mnan: ci bgyi'i bka' nyan 'bangs su g.yar dam bcas:

bod khams gling dgu'i dbus su byon pa'i tshe: gnyug mar gnas pa'i mgur lha dge bsnyen dang: sa bdag brtan ma gnod sbyin gtum pa'i sde: glo bur lhags pa'i bdud btsan pe har sogs: thams cad srog snying drangs shing bka' bsgos tshe: 'da' dka'i tha tshig dang du blangs pa ltar: bdag ni rig 'dzin slob dpon de yi gdung: khyed cag sngon gyi lha 'dre'i rigs yin pas: chos nyid bden tshig rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon: dpal gyi pha 'bab gtor ma 'di longs la: gangs can mtha' dbus kun tu bde ba dang: bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: yi dam lha tshogs gar dgu'i rol rtsed sgyur: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma las la 'dus: 'da' dka'i g.yar dam gnyan po rjes dgongs la: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma brngan du bzhes: bdag gis bcol pa'i las rnams thams cad kun: ma g.yel myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod:

dmigs bsal phyir zlog las bcol phyir: nyams pa'i gzugs brnyan sbyar pa la: dgra bgegs dgug bstim tshogs su bsgral: zas su bsngo zhing phrin las gsol: hūm̐ hūm̐: rig 'dzin bla ma rol pa'i byin rlabs dang: yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu rtsal gyis: bstan dang sgrub la 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs kun: mtshan ma rten tu bcas pa 'dir khug cig: dpal gyi thugs nas pho nya skar ltar spros: lcags kyus zungs shig zhags pas dam du chings: lcags sgrog drwa bar dril bus myos su chug: lha dang phral nas gzugs la dbyer med bstim: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru shrī he ru ka sarba sha trūn bibhnān badzra aṅku sha dza: badzra pā sha hūm̐: badzra spho ṭa baṃ: badzra ghāṇḍe ho: badzra pra be sha ya phaṭa: badzra ā be sha ya a a: hūm̐: khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la yas: rgyud drug 'khor ba'i bag chags gzhom pa'i phyir: tshe bsod ye shes zer gyis bdag la thim: byang sems bde chen chu yis dri ma bkrus: rnam shes dbyings rig dbyer med phyag rgyar drongs: phung po sha khrag rdul phran bzhin du rlog: he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i brtul zhugs kyis: mngon spyod stobs kyi phrin las yongs rdzogs mdzod: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba sha trūn bighnān hūm̐ phaṭa mā ra ya rbad: hūm̐: bstan la gnod byed dgra bgegs ru dra kun: thugs rje khros pas bsgral pa'i sha khrag rus: brgyud gsum dregs tshogs rgya mtsho'i zhal du bstab: dgyes par bzhes la bcol pa'i phrin las mdzod: aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs pa ri bā ra sarba sha trūṃ bighnān ma hā māṃ sa rakta kiṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hi khā hi: hūm̐ bhyo: ye shes chos skyong tshogs rnams dbyings nas bzhengs: 'jig rten dregs pa'i dpung tshogs las la chos: pho nya las mkhan myur ba'i shugs skyed la: phyir zlog drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: rig 'dzin sgrub mchog bdag cag 'khor bcas la:

byang chub sgrub la bar du gcod pa yi: sngon las 'phral rkyen dus min 'chi ba zlog: 'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug zlog: 'byung ba dgra gshed 'khrugs pa'i las sbyor zlog: byad phur rbod gtong than dang ltas ngan zlog: bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad dang 'tshe ba zlog: stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs dang bar gcod zlog: glo bur ye 'drog byur dang sri keg zlog: sde brgyad gtum po'i khengs log cho 'phrul zlog: mtha' dmag kla klo gdug pa'i 'tshubs 'gyur zlog: ban bon skye bo'i dmod ngan ya ga zlog: 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi chos nyid klong du zlog: gsang ba'i dgra gsum 'od gsal dbyings su zlog: bar gcod 'phrang gsum ka dag chen por zlog: gzung 'dzin rnam rtog rdzogs pa chen por zlog: bzlog go mi mthun thams cad dgra la zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan bar gcod bgegs la sgyur: thams cad lhun mnyam gnyug ma khyab brdal klong: bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: sarba sa ma ya e dzaḥbhyo aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥbhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces bcol gtor ma zor du 'phang: hūm̐ hūm̐: sgrub gnas gsang ba'i pho brang chen po yi: rnam thar bzhi ldan 'od gsal dbyings kyi sgo: tshad med bzhi ldan ye shes phyag rgyas dbye: dpal gyi dam tshig can rnams da gshegs shig: hūm̐ hrī: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams thams cad kun: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang: gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs skur ston la: drag po zor gyi gzu dang dpang mdzod cig: hūm̐ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og dbang sgyur ba'i: dkar phyogs dpal mgon lha klu 'khor bcas kyang: gtor ma'i zor lam dbye phyir sku bzur la: bzlog bsgyur las kyi dpung dang grogs la chos: dus gsum rig 'dzin zhi khro'i tshogs rnams kyis: bdud dang ru dra'i bar chad 'dul ba'i tshe: ji ltar rtags bstan mthu rtsal phyungs pa bzhin:

zor chen rdzas kyi mthu stobs nus pa skyed: chad mdo'i tha tshig gnyan po la gnas pa'i: ye shes 'jig rten las kyi pho nya'i tshogs: glog ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis dmag la chos: srin po khros pa'i rngam brjid ya la la: dpal gyi ru mtshon gnyan po lhabs se lhab: bhyo zlog dmod pa'i gad rgyangs 'u ru ru: thun rdzas gtor ma'i thog 'beb sha ra ra: zor 'phen bstan la gnod pa'i dgra la 'phen: bar gcod rtsom pa'i 'dre dang bgegs la 'phen: bod khams phung byed kla klo'i steng du 'phen: phyi nang g.yo 'khrugs 'gong po'i steng du 'phen: dgra dpung thams cad thal ba'i rdul bzhin rlogs: bgegs dpung ma lus phye ma dum bur thong: bzlog bsgyur zor gyi phrin las grub par mdzod: oṃ badzra ma hā gu ru shrī he ru ka e dzaḥbhyo aḥyaḥmaḥduḥruḥtsaḥshaḥnaḥs ma ya ma hā sha rī raṃ bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces 'phang thal mo dul mo brdab: rten dang lam gyi bar gcod kun: rjes shul lhag med brlag par bsam: stong nyid ka dag ngang du bzhag: rig 'dzin byin rlabs mthu btsan zhing: dam can srung ma rtsal ldan pas: byang chub sgrub pa'i bar gcod kun: nges par bzlog 'gyur the tshom med: rjes su bshal chu'i bdud rtsi dang: gtor mas phyi rol skyong ba'i ma: che zhe 'khor bcas mchod pa ni: mthun rdzas 'dod yon sprin du brlab: bhrūm̐ ratna ba liṃ ta trāṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho: hūm̐ bhyo: bran dang bka' yi tshogs kyi 'du ba'i bdag: khrag 'thung de bzhin nyid brnyes nam mkha'i sku: padma thod phreng sbyan sngar dam mnos pa'i: bod skyong brtan ma 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs shig: ma ma bhyo e ā ralli hrīṃ hrīṃ dzaḥdza: bhyo: he ru ka dpal sku yi rigs kyi yum: bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong: gangs kyi g.yu bun rdo rje kun tu bzang: 'brog chen 'khor 'dul rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso:

drag shul bdud kyi bu mo mched sde bzhi: skyong ma ya ma 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig rjes dgongs bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes: 'khor srungs rkyen zlog tshe bsod dpal 'byor skyed: gangs can mtha' dbus nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sol: lo legs 'bru dang rkang 'gros nor phyugs spel: bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: bhyo: he ru ka dpal gsung gi rigs kyi yum: gangs dkar sha med rdo rje spyan gcig ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo dang: rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: gtum chen gnod sbyin bu mo mched sde bzhi: skyong ma ya ma 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig rjes dgongs bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes: 'khor srungs rkyen zlog tshe bsod dpal 'byor skyed: gangs can mtha' dbus nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sol: lo legs 'bru dang rkang 'gros nor phyugs spel: bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: bhyo: he ru ka dpal thugs kyi rigs kyi yum: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong: btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje zu le sman: sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo bsil: yid 'phrog sman gyi bu mo mched sde bzhi: skyong ma ya ma 'bum phrag 'khor dang bcas: dam tshig rjes dgongs bshal chu'i gtor ma bzhes: 'khor srungs rkyen zlog tshe bsod dpal 'byor skyed: gangs can mtha' dbus nad mug 'khrugs rtsod sol: lo legs 'bru dang rkang 'gros nor phyugs spel: bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: ma mā ta tā te tai taṃ tāṃ la lā li lī kha rakmā ma ma sring 'gro ma pra tītstsha i maṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: yā hi gatstsha: las la myur ba'i tshul dang bcas: dgyes bzhin rang gnas gshegs par bsam: las mjug mthar phyin bya ba'i phyir: rdo rje bro yi cho ga ni:

gtor gzhong ri rab lhun po'i 'og: dam sri dpung bcas rgyas gdab bsam: hūm̐: e nṛ tri sarba sha trūn bighnān dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐ hrī: rtsa gsum lha tshogs dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor du: bar chad byed pa'i bdud dang dam sri'i dpung: rdo rje ri rab lhun po'i 'og tu bkug: mi 'gyur ye shes lta bas rgyas gdab bo: sarba sha trūn bighnān st+wambha ya nan: oṃ: dkar zlum yā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum rdo rje rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: zhe sdang chos dbyings ye shes phyag rgyar rdzogs: mi mthun gtum po thams cad zhi gyur cig: hūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru kro dha shāntiṃ ku ru swā hā: trāṃ: ser mnyam mā yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum rin chen rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: nga rgyal mnyam nyid ye shes klong du thim: rdo rje'i gzi brjid ye shes rgyas gyur cig: trāṃ ratna ma hā gu ru kro dha puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ: hrīḥ dmar 'khyil waṃ gi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum padma rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: 'dod chags sor rtog ye shes thig ler 'khyil: yid 'phrog 'dod rgu dbang du 'dus gyur cig: hrīḥpadma ma hā gu ru kro dha wa shaṃ ku ru ho: hūm̐: mthing nag e yi tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du: rtsa gsum las kyi rigs kyi bro brdungs pas: phrag dog bya grub ye shes klong du thim: mi mthun dgra bgegs thams cad brlag gyur cig: hūm̐ karma ma hā gu ru kro dha mā ra ya phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐: tshig ni brjod bral skye med gnyug ma'i dbyangs: glu ni rol pa 'gag med ye shes glu: bro ni gnyis med zung 'jug bde chen gar: rtsa gsum zhi khro sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul gyis: 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi ri rab 'og tu mnan: gsang ba'i dgra gsum rdo rje'i phyag rgyas btab: bar chad 'phrang gsum ye shes me yis bsreg: thams cad lhun rdzogs ye shes dbyings su thim:

sarba bighnān sha trūn st+waṃ bha ya mo ha ya dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ a: slar yang gtor snod kha phye la: rin chen sman 'bru bdud rtsis bkang: tshe bsod dpal 'byor yon tan dang: bde chen ye shes rgyas par bsam: gsum pa dngos grub blang ba ni: mda' dar g.yab cing gdung shugs bskyed: srid dang zhi ba'i dwangs bcud kun: dngos grub rdzas la bkug cing bstim: hrī: rje btsun o rgyan padma tshe dpag med: rtsa gsum rgyal ba rab 'byams dbyings nas bzhengs: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams las la bskul: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi: bla tshe chad nyams yar ba rang sor tshud: 'jig rten snod bcud 'byung ba'i dwangs ma sdus: ye shes gzi byin 'od kyi thig ler skyil: sgrub rten rdzas la 'khor 'das dwangs bcud stims: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag la: tshe khug g.yang skyobs mchog thun dngos grub dang: 'chi med rdo rje'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi ā yu ṣe swā hā: tshe bhrūm̐: g.yu bhrūm̐: g.yu tshe bhrūm̐: ā yurdzñā na g.yu tshe bhrūm̐: zhes bzlas dwangs bcud gzi byin sbar: de nas rten dang sgrub pa'i rdzas: spyi bor blang zhing gnas gsum gtugs: tshe dang gal sogs longs spyod bya: hūm̐ hrī: ma bcos spros bral dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas: rig pa rang snang dgongs klong 'du 'bral med: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs rnams kyis: skye med chos sku'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: bde chen lhun grub 'od gsal dkyil 'khor nas: gang 'dul skur snang brda thabs du mar ston: rigs gsum rig 'dzin tshom bu 'bum sde yis: 'gag med longs sku'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rig rtsal rol pa'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nas: rgyud lung man ngag snyan brgyud chos 'khor bskor: rgya bod rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtsho yis:

'gro 'dul sprul sku'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: hūm̐ hrī: bde chen padma drwa ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag thod phreng rtsal: bka' babs chu bo bzhi 'dus slob dpon dang: yi dam dpal chen brgyad kyi rig pa 'dzin: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro 'bum phrag yangs pa'i tshogs: dang po bsnyen cing bar du dbyer med bsgrubs: deng 'dir dngos grub gsol ba'i dus lags na: thugs rje chen po'i gzi byin bskyed du gsol: nam mkha'i gzugs can 'gran tu med pa yi: mtshan dpe sku yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rdo rje mi shigs nā da'i sgra chen po: tshangs dbyangs gsung gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gdod nas rnam dag sku gsum thig ler 'khyil: 'od gsal thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: stobs dang rdzu 'phrul dbang bcu'i gter chen po: 'dod 'byung yon tan dngos grub bstsal du gsol: gang 'dul thabs kyis gdul bya'i re ba skong: thogs med phrin las dngos grub bstsal du gsol: rab 'byams mdo rgyud bka' yi dngos grub stsol: rdo rje'i lung mchog gter gyi dngos grub stsol: man ngag snying po gdams pa'i dngos grub stsol: thun mong yid bzhin 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: khyad par mchog gsang don gyi dngos grub stsol: 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bde chen ye shes rtogs pa'i dngos grub stsol: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇḍa la kā ya wā ka tsitta gu ṇa karma dzñā na badzra sarba siddhi pha la oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā siddhi ātma ko3 haṃ: slar yang gtang rag mchod bstod bya: nongs pa'i tshogs rnams bzod par gsol: ho: chos kyi dbyings la nyes pa'i skyon med kyang: bdag cag ma rig glo bur 'khrul pa yis: nongs pa gang mchis snying nas bzod par gsol:

dag cing tshangs pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol: yi ge brgya pa ci nus brjod: bzhi pa rtag chad mtha' bsal phyir: snang cha lha yi 'khor lo kun: 'od gsal stong pa'i dbyings su bsdu: rjes thob zung 'jug lha skur ldang: a: snod bcud gzhal yas khang dang lha yi sku: rtag mtha' gzung 'dzin mtshan ma sbyang ba'i phyir: mkha' la 'ja' bzhin 'od gsal dbyings su thim: ma bcos skye med gnyug ma'i ngang du bzhag: ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badzra swa bhā ba ātma ko3 haṃ: hūm̐: slar yang bden gnyis dbyer med chen po'i ngang: chad pa'i mtha' dang stong pa las grol phyir: snang cha 'chi med padma thod phreng rtsal: mi phyed rdo rje gsum gyi phyag rgyar bzhengs: badzra ma hā gu ru kā ya wā ka tsitta ātma ko3 haṃ: lnga pa bsngo smon shis brjod ni: ho: khyab brdal chos dbyings chen po'i dkyil 'khor du: rig 'dzin mchog gi bsnyen cing sgrub la sogs: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge ba gang mchis pa: bla med byang chub snying por bsngo bar bgyi: bsod nams 'di yis bdag gzhan sems can kun: tshe ring nad med 'dod rgu'i 'byor pa rgyas: theg mchog chos kyi longs spyod chen po yis: rtag tu bde ba'i dpal la rol par shog: rnam par smin pas rlung sems lha skur bzhengs: tshe la dbang thob phyag rgya'i rigs su shar: lhun gyis grub pa'i zung 'jug sgyu ma yis: sku dang ye shes go 'phang myur 'grub shog: oṃ: chos sku'i dbyings las bde chen longs spyod rdzogs: sprul pa'i rnam rol padma thod phreng rtsal: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi: byin rlabs sprin phung 'khrigs pa'i bkra shis shog: 'od gsal ngang las bden gnyis dbyer med sku: bsam yas sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol par shar: rab 'byams yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs kyi: dngos grub char du bsnyil ba'i bkra shis shog: phyi dang nang gi gnas yul dur khrod du:

bde stong gar mdzad zhi chags khros pa'i nyams: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyi: 'dod rgu'i 'bras bu smin pa'i bkra shis shog: rgyal ba'i bstan srung bka' yi bya ra mdzad: log 'dren tshar gcod skal ldan rjes su 'dzin: rdo rje'i chos srung nor lha gter bdag gi: phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i bkra shis shog: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snying po dar zhing rgyas: bstan 'dzin thugs mthun sku tshe mdzad phrin 'phel: 'jig rten kun tu nad mug mtshon 'khrug zhi: rtag tu bde skyid dpal gnas bkra shis shog:

ces brjod me tog phyogs bcur 'thor: snyan 'gyur rol mo yun du bya: dga' zhing spro ba'i nyams bskyangs la: chos spyod bcu la brtson par bya: sa ma ya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ bsgrub gzhi 'od gsal bde gshegs snying: 'chi med rtsa gsum don gyi lha: gdod nas 'du 'bral med pa'i phyir: bden gnyis dbyer med chen por blta: sgrub byed smin dang grol ba'i lam: rdo rje theg pa'i gsang ba che: snang stong bde stong rig cing stong: bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug chen por bsgom: sgrub pa mthar phyin 'bras bu ni: sku dang ye shes phrin las bdag: mkha' khyab rtag pa lhun grub mchog: shin tu rnam grol chen por 'char: de lta bu yi lam gyi rim: zab cing rgya che mkha' 'dra ba'i: snying po mthar thug rig 'dzin bzhi'i: go 'phang mchog tu sgrub pa'i phyir: lus brgya'i mgo dang dpral ba'i mig: khog pa'i snying dang zungs khrag ltar: ma byung 'byung bar dka' ba'i chos: rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus chos kyi mdzod: da lta rang byung he ru ka: 'chi med padma bdag nyid kyis: thugs kyi dwangs ma mngon phyungs nas: sngon gyi smon lam 'brel pa yi: mnga' bdag yab sras rnams la gtad: dad dang mos pas rtse gcig chongs: bai ro tsa na nyid la gdams: bshad dang sgrub pas gsal bar phyes: ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs la bstims: mkha' 'gro brda yi yi ger bris: ma 'ongs rig 'dzin rje 'bangs rnams: bsam bzhin sprul pa bzung ba'i ched: bka' shog sa yi gter du sbos: las can rnams dang 'phrad nas kyang: yid bzhin nor bu'i mdzod chen dbye: las kyi rim pa 'di nyid kyang: klog dang 'dzin pa lta ci smos: dpe rgyud tsam zhig 'chang bas kyang: rtsa gsum lha tshogs sprin bzhin 'du: yul khams kun tu dge legs 'byung: 'brel tshad byang chub lam la 'god: khyad par o rgyan bdag nyid kyi: dbus gtsang sgrub gnas nyer gcig dang: mdo khams gnas chen nyer lnga la:

'di nyid tshogs su bsgrub pa na: bod khams bstan pa yun du 'phel: mchog tu yar mar tshes bcu'i dus: 'byor tshogs thams cad rdzas su bsham: mos shing gdung bas rgyud bskul tshe: o rgyan rig 'dzin thams cad dang: mkha' 'gro'i 'du ba dngos su 'ong: chu bo bzhi yi ye shes 'phel: sgrub sde dgu yi dngos grub thob: rtsa khams rlung la byin brlabs pas: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi myur du 'grub: de phyir snying la gces par zungs: yar bar ma dor sgrub la 'bungs: 'gro 'dul bstan pa mtha' rgyas 'gyur: sa ma yaḥ rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: zab rgya: gnyer rgya: gsang rgya: gdams rgya: sa ma ya: kha tham: gu hya: 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas lha mdo 'bur mo bde chen padma bkod nas dngos grub tu thob pa'o// //
